# dsh-notification-badge

> Desktop, browser + webhook notifications **and an attention badge on the app icon** for
> [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) on **macOS · Linux · Windows**:
> know when your agent **finishes a turn**, **hits an error**, or is **waiting for your approval** —
> without watching the tab.

Long agent turns are the norm: you kick off a task, switch away, and come back to find the agent
finished five minutes ago — or worse, stuck on an approval prompt the whole time.
`dsh-notification-badge` listens to the harness's own lifecycle events, pings you the moment your
attention is needed, and keeps a count on the application icon while you are away.

## What it does

| Event | Trigger | Default |
|---|---|---|
| **Agent finished** | `agent/status` flips `running → idle`, and the turn ran ≥ `minTurnDurationMs` | on |
| **Agent error** | `agent/error` (a step or turn errored) | on |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` waterfall (observe-only; always delegates with `next()`) | on |
| **Waiting for you** | a session's `pendingInteraction` appears (browser half) | on |
| **App-icon badge** | either of the above while the window is not focused (desktop shell) | on |

Each event can go to:

- **Desktop notification** — zero dependencies: `osascript` (macOS), `notify-send` (Linux),
  PowerShell toast (Windows), optionally with a sound on macOS.
- **Browser notification** — the standard `Notification` API in the Web UI.
- **Webhook** — a JSON `POST` with a Slack-compatible `text` field, so a Slack incoming webhook
  works as-is. Other services need their own field: Discord, for example, ignores `text` and wants
  the same string as `content`, so point the webhook at a small relay (or a Slack-compatible
  bridge) when you need Discord messages.
- **App-icon badge** — the count of sessions that need you, on the macOS Dock tile, the Windows
  taskbar button, or the Linux launcher entry.

## Where each channel fires

| Channel | Runs on | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop (`desktop`) | the machine **running the `dsh` server** | `dsh web` on your own machine |
| Browser (`browser`) | the machine **viewing the Web UI** | a remote server, or any Web UI use |
| Badge (`badge`) | the machine **viewing the Web UI**, desktop shell only | seeing "3 things need you" at a glance |
| Webhook (`webhookUrl`) | wherever the URL points | phones, Slack, unattended runs |

Browser notifications ask for permission on your first click or keypress, and by default popups
appear **only while the window is hidden or unfocused** — a window you are looking at already has
your attention (set `browserOnlyWhenHidden: false` to change that).

The badge counts a session once, while the window is unfocused, and clears the moment you come
back — it means "things you have not looked at yet", not "unread messages". Sessions that stay
short (`minTurnDurationMs`) are ignored, and subagent sessions never notify or badge.

### Desktop and browser channels overlap on a local desktop

On the DeepSeek Harness **desktop app** the server and the page run on the same machine, so both
default-on channels fire for one event: a native `osascript`/`notify-send` notification from the
host **and** a page `Notification` (which Electron also renders natively). That is two popups per
turn. Keep one:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml
- id: notify-badge
  name: dsh-notification-badge
  config:
    desktop: false     # the page already notifies, and owns the app-icon badge
```

`desktop: true` is the right default for `dsh web` on a remote or headless machine, where the page
is somewhere else.

> **Do not run this together with `dsh-dock-badge`.** Both drive the same Badging API and each
> clears the icon when the page loads, so they overwrite each other's count. This plugin covers
> everything that one does (and reads pending interactions from `uiSession.sessionStatus`, which
> the session list does not expose), so keep only one of them enabled.

## Install

The package is a bundle: `dsh plugin add` writes the dependency and selects the bundle row.

```sh
# Web / headless profiles:
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-notification-badge
```

The **desktop** profile is owned by the application: install it from **Settings → Plugins** in the
DeepSeek Harness app. `dsh plugin --profile desktop add …` also works, but only with the app fully
quit and the profile initialized once (`dsh` refuses to touch an uninitialized desktop profile).

The package ships plain ESM JavaScript — no build step, so a git or registry install needs no
`allowBuilds` entry. The Web UI picks the client bundle up on the next load.

<details>
<summary>Manual installation</summary>

Add the dependency to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` and list it as a bundle:

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["…", "dsh-notification-badge"] } }
```

</details>

## Configuration

Override the row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: notify-badge
  name: dsh-notification-badge
  config:
    minTurnDurationMs: 10000        # only notify for turns ≥ 10s
    webhookUrl: 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/XXX/YYY/ZZZ'
    notifyOnApproval: true
    desktop: true
    browser: true
    badge: true
    badgeMode: count                # count | dot
    title: 'DSH'
```

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `notifyOnIdle` | boolean | `true` | Notify when a turn finishes |
| `notifyOnError` | boolean | `true` | Notify on `agent/error` |
| `notifyOnApproval` | boolean | `true` | Notify when a tool call awaits approval |
| `minTurnDurationMs` | number | `5000` | Skip notifications for quick turns |
| `desktop` | boolean | `true` | Native desktop notification on the server host |
| `browser` | boolean | `true` | Browser `Notification` popups in the Web UI |
| `browserOnlyWhenHidden` | boolean | `true` | Suppress popups while you are looking at the window |
| `webhookUrl` | string | `''` | Optional POST target (Slack-compatible payload) |
| `title` | string | `'DeepSeek Harness'` | Title for desktop and browser notifications |
| `sound` | string | `'Glass'` | macOS: a system sound name (looked up in `~/Library/Sounds`, `/Library/Sounds`, `/System/Library/Sounds`) or an audio file path (absolute, or relative to `~/Library/Sounds`); `''` is silent |
| `windowsAppId` | string | `''` | Windows: AppUserModelID the toast is attributed to; empty uses the posting process's registered identity |
| `badge` | boolean | `true` | Put the attention count on the application icon |
| `badgeDesktopOnly` | boolean | `true` | Only badge in the desktop shell (a browser tab has no app icon) |
| `badgeMode` | `count` \| `dot` | `count` | Number of sessions, or an unnumbered dot |
| `badgeMaxCount` | number | `99` | Highest number rendered |
| `badgeOnIdle` | boolean | `true` | Count a finished turn |
| `badgeOnApproval` | boolean | `true` | Count a session waiting on you (including one already waiting at load) |
| `badgeClearOnFocus` | boolean | `true` | Clear the badge when the window is focused or visible again |

Every field is declared `.volatile()`, so the values are **live**: the `dsh-settings` document
serves them, and a change applies without a reload. `webhookUrl` is `role('secret')`, so its value
is stripped before settings cross the wire to the browser.

### Webhook payload

```json
{
  "text": "Agent finished — done in 2m 14s",
  "summary": "Agent finished",
  "body": "done in 2m 14s",
  "level": "info",
  "ts": "2026-08-21T12:34:56.000Z"
}
```

## The app-icon badge

The Dock tile belongs to the Electron **browser process**, so a host-side plugin can never touch it.
The renderer does not need to: **Electron implements the standard Badging API in the browser
process**, so `navigator.setAppBadge(n)` from the page reaches the same code path as
`app.setBadgeCount()` — no shell patch, no IPC channel, no preload hook. The API is
`[SecureContext]`, and the desktop shell serves the UI from `dsh-app://` (registered `secure: true`).

Three sharp edges, all handled:

- **Never call `setAppBadge(0)`.** Chromium treats a numeric zero as a protocol violation and

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.readme_text:
AgentPilot：跨设备的开源 Agent 工作台
连接工作设备，在桌面、手机和 Web 管理 AI Agent。

开源 · 多种 Agent · 会话与工作区 · 自托管

下载客户端 · 部署并打开 Web · English

**AgentPilot** 是跨设备的开源 Agent 工作台。连接运行 **Codex、Claude Code 或 DeepSeek Harness** 的工作设备，在桌面、手机和 Web 查看会话、回复请求、管理文件与终端。Agent 在连接的工作设备上执行任务。 ## 下载与入口 在工作设备上安装桌面客户端，再通过手机、平板或 Web 访问。Linux 和无图形界面的服务器可使用 Connector CLI 接入。各客户端连接你自己部署的服务实例。 | 平台 | 获取客户端 | | --- | --- | | **macOS** | [GitHub Releases · Universal DMG](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/releases) | | **Windows** | [GitHub Releases · x64 安装包](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/releases) | | **Android** | [GitHub Releases · APK](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/releases) | | **iOS / iPadOS** | [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/agent-pilot) · [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/AgentPilot) | | **Web** | 部署自己的服务后打开对应地址（见[自托管快速开始](#自托管快速开始)） | | **Linux / headless** | [运行 Connector CLI](connector/README.md) | > 正式发布后，上面的安装包链接会指向对应 Release；当前 `main` 是开发主线，源码中的新修复不一定已进入安装包。
平台要求、安装包与更新说明 - macOS：Apple Silicon / Intel 通用，已签名、公证；需要 macOS 12 及以上。 - Windows：x64 桌面工作台，含本机 Connector；当前安装包未做代码签名。 - Android：Android 8.0 及以上。 - iOS / iPadOS：在 App Store 下载安装；也可以通过 TestFlight 安装测试版，以邀请页显示的可用状态为准。 - Linux / headless：运行 Connector 接入工作设备，通过其他客户端操作。 各端 PATCH 版本独立发布，数据库 schema revision 单独编号。
## Agent 与工作区管理 | 你想做的事 | 在 AgentPilot 中 | | --- | --- | | **管理项目与会话** | 在设备、项目和会话之间切换，通过时间线（Timeline）查看运行进度。 | | **审批操作与回复请求** | 响应工具审批和输入请求；按 Runtime 能力打断或继续任务。 | | **查看文件与使用终端** | 浏览与预览文件、上传下载附件，打开远程 shell 和交互式终端。 | | **配置 Agent** | 配置 Codex、Claude Code 和 DSH；根据对应 Runtime 支持的能力选择模型、权限与操作。 | Runtime 是工作设备上运行和连接 Agent 的组件。模型账号和调用费用遵循所使用 Agent 的规则。各 Runtime 的能力存在差异，具体操作以客户端显示为准。[DSH 接入说明 →](dsh-bridge-next/README.md) ## 桌面、移动端与 Web 用手机查看进展、回复 Agent，在平板上打开工作区，回到电脑后继续处理。同一服务、同一账号下，自己的设备和会话可以从不同客户端访问。 **手机负责控制，工作设备负责执行。** 远程使用时，工作设备需要保持开机、联网，并让 Connector 与对应 Runtime 正常运行。 ## 首次使用 1. **登录服务。** 安装客户端或打开 Web，填写你的服务地址并登录。 2. **连接工作设备。** Desktop 集成本机 Connector；服务器与无图形环境使用 [Connector CLI](connector/README.md)。 3. **准备 Agent 和项目。** 在工作设备上配置 Runtime、账号与工作目录，创建或打开会话。 4. **从其他设备访问。** 在手机、平板或另一台电脑登录同一服务和账号，访问自己的设备与任务。 ## 执行位置与自托管 Agent 使用 Connector 所在机器的工作区与权限。服务部署在你自己的服务器上，客户端填入该地址即可。 ```mermaid flowchart LR Clients["桌面 · 手机 · Web"] <-->|"访问与控制"| Server["AgentPilot Server"] Server <-->|"Connector RPC"| Connector["工作设备上的 Connector"] Connector <--> Agents["Codex · Claude Code · DSH"] Connector <--> Workspace["工作区 · 文件 · 终端"] ``` 会话内容、Timeline 和上传附件等数据会按功能经过或存储在 Server。自托管时，这些服务端数据由你部署的实例处理。 ### 使用 Docker 部署 克隆仓库后，在根目录运行以下命令，先替换示例密码和密钥： ```bash POSTGRES_PASSWORD=replace-with-a-strong-password \ AGENT_SERVER_SECRET=replace-with-a-long-random-secret \ docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.postgres.yml up --build ``` 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:5174`，从 Server 日志取得 setup token，完成首位管理员设置。Compose 包含 PostgreSQL、Redis、迁移任务以及托管 Web 的 Server。 [完整部署步骤](docker/README.md) · [Server 文档](server/README.md) ## 开发与贡献 开发环境使用 **Python 3.12+ / uv / Node.js 22 / Corepack + Yarn**。 | 想了解什么 | 从这里开始 | | --- | --- | | Agent 接入与本机执行 | [Connector](connector/README.md) | | Web 与桌面客户端 | [Web 源码](web-next/) · [Desktop Workbench](desktop-workbench/README.md) | | 原生移动客户端 | [Android](android/README.md) · [iOS 源码](ios/) | | DSH 集成 | [DSH Bridge Next](dsh-bridge-next/README.md) | 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/issues) 反馈问题，或通过 [Pull Requests](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/pulls) 参与改进。报告问题时，请附上客户端版本、系统、Runtime 类型和复现步骤，并移除日志中的凭据。 ## 交流与反馈 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/issues) 反馈问题、通过 [Pull Requests](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot/pulls) 参与改进。如果项目对你有用，欢迎在 [GitHub](https://github.com/lxfebd/AgentPilot) 点个 Star。 ## 开源许可 MIT。本项目的品牌、下载入口与社区以本项目仓库为准。 > **致谢**：AgentPilot 基于 [Agents Anywhere](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/Agents-Anywhere)（MIT License）二次开发并更名。感谢原作者的开源工作。

plugins.description: LCU (Codex computer use) for DeepSeek Harness: macOS app control with an approval dialog, via an MCP adapter.
plugins.readme_text:
# @kinocode/dsh-lcu

[日本語](README.ja.md) | English

[LCU](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu) (Codex computer use, decoupled from the Codex app) as a
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin. The agent gets
`mcp__lcu__js` / `mcp__lcu__js_reset` to read and operate native macOS apps.

DSH's stock `dsh-mcp-client` cannot answer LCU's per-app approval requests (MCP *elicitation*), so a plain
MCP mount fails with `createElicitation is unavailable`. This plugin launches LCU behind a small adapter
(`lib/adapter.mjs`) that handles approval.

## Requirements
- macOS (Apple Silicon) with the official **ChatGPT desktop app** installed
- **LCU** installed, e.g. `~/.local/share/lcu` ([installation guide](https://github.com/amontlabs/lcu/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)); `--runtime-only` is enough
- macOS permissions: Accessibility (ChatGPT Computer Use) and Screen Recording (ChatGPT)

## Install
```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @kinocode/dsh-lcu
```
Restart DSH and start a new session. Other LCU location: set `prefix` (below) or `LCU_PREFIX`.

## Approval modes
Set in your profile patch:
```yaml
- id: lcu
  config:
    approval: ask      # ask (default) | all | deny
```
| `approval` | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `ask` | A macOS dialog asks you: Deny / Allow this time / Always allow (Touch ID, same as `lcu apps allow`). Closed, timed out, or answered faster than a human → denied |
| `all` | Approve every app without asking |
| `deny` | Always deny |

In every mode the adapter refuses apps the agent could use to approve itself: DSH, terminals, Claude,
`osascript` / System Events. Other config: `prefix`, `toolCallTimeoutMs`.

## What the adapter does
- Exposes only `js` and `js_reset` (host-only tools such as `turn_ended` are hidden)
- Saves screenshots as files under `$TMPDIR/dsh-lcu-shots/` and returns the path (view with `read_image`),
  because the MCP client turns images into placeholders
- Reconnects to LCU on the next call if it exits

## Safety
`all` lets the agent operate any app, including browsers and password managers. Prefer `ask`.
This is an unofficial community plugin; it is not affiliated with OpenAI or amontlabs. The ChatGPT app and
its runtime keep their own terms; this package contains neither.

## License
MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 多引擎搜索插件：原生 web_search 兼容，必应/百度/搜狗/360 + Tavily/Exa，网页正文抓取与 web_research 深度收集，零模型 token、可配置、可回退。
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek 搜索（dsh-deepseek-search）

[![CI](https://github.com/a2042798096-debug/dsh-deepseek-search/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/a2042798096-debug/dsh-deepseek-search/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端补上“真正能上网查资料”的能力：**多引擎搜索 + 网页正文抓取 + 一次调用完成深度收集**，并提供一个中文设置页。

仓库地址：<https://github.com/a2042798096-debug/dsh-deepseek-search>

- 原生 `web_search` 会自动切换到本插件的多引擎搜索链，模型不需要换工具名。
- 新增 `web_research`：搜索 → 选页 → 抓正文 → 汇总，带出处。
- 新增 `web_collect`：一次读多个 URL 的正文。
- 新增 `web_engines`：查看引擎启用/可用状态。
- 设置页可开关引擎、填 API Key、调超时与正文上限、直接试搜。

> 当前版本默认接入国内可直连的 **必应、百度、搜狗、360**；Tavily / Exa / Firecrawl / Brave / Serper 需要 Key，DuckDuckGo / SearXNG 默认关闭。在部分中国大陆网络中，Google、DuckDuckGo、Brave、SearXNG 公共实例可能连接超时，所以没有把它们设为默认。

---

## 优势

- **不消耗 DeepSeek 模型 token**：默认四个免费引擎直接发 HTTP 请求，不走“辅助模型回合”；只有你自己启用的 Tavily/Exa 等 API 引擎才使用对应服务商的额度。
- **多源交叉，而不是单一官方结果**：必应、百度、搜狗、360 并行检索，按加权 RRF 合并、按 URL 去重；多个引擎同时命中的结果会自动加分。
- **一次调用完成“查 + 读”**：`web_research` 把“多查询 → 多引擎 → 选页 → 抓正文 → 带出处汇总”串起来，不用模型来回十几轮。
- **原生工具零迁移**：`web_search` / `web_fetch` 的名字和参数不变，已有提示词、技能、工作流不用改；只是 `web_search` 背后的提供方换成了多引擎。
- **失败隔离**：某个引擎超时、被反爬或改版，只影响它自己；其他引擎继续返回。连续失败会记录在 `web_engines` 的“最近错误”里，方便判断是 Key、网络还是反爬。
- **直连失败可回退**：免费引擎的 GET 请求在直连被重置/超时时，会自动再走一次 DSH 的 `ctx.web.fetch()`，复用它配置的代理、DNS 校验和安全限制。
- **隐私可控**：每个引擎都能单独关闭；API Key 只写本机；设置页明确提示查询会发往哪些引擎；不想让查询离开 DeepSeek 时，可以只保留官方提供方。
- **中文场景优化**：默认启用百度、搜狗、360，覆盖公众号、CSDN、知乎、博客园等中文来源；搜狗/360 的 `/link` 跳转壳会自动解析成真实地址。
- **上下文可控**：`web_research` 支持 `includeContent: false` 摘要模式、`maxPages`、每页字符上限和总输出上限，调研长文时也能控制上下文。
- **开源可扩展**：新增一个引擎只需要改 `config.mjs` 的目录、`engines.mjs` 的 runner/parser，再加一个离线 fixture。

## 与原版 DSH 网页搜索的区别

| 维度 | 原版 DSH | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索方式 | DeepSeek 官方：`deepseek-official`（Messages 原生搜索）或 `deepseek-search-api` | 本插件注册 `deepseek-search`，聚合多个搜索引擎 |
| 引擎数量 | 单一官方提供方 | 默认 4 个免费引擎；可选 7 个 API/自建引擎 |
| 成本 | 一次搜索通常是一次辅助模型请求，消耗 token/官方额度 | 免费引擎零模型 token；API 引擎使用各家额度 |
| 延迟 | 更接近一次模型回合 | 并行 HTTP，通常 1–3 秒返回搜索结果；抓正文另计 |
| 结果 | 官方排序与结构化来源 | 加权 RRF、跨引擎去重、来源引擎标注 |
| 工具 | `web_search`、`web_fetch` | 原生两个不变，另加 `web_research`、`web_collect`、`web_engines` |
| 网页抓取 | `http` 或 `deepseek-fetch-api` | 仍走 `ctx.web.fetch()`，默认固定 `http` |
| 配置入口 | 设置 → 内置插件设置 → 网页搜索 | 设置 → **DeepSeek 搜索** |
| 查询去向 | `api.deepseek.com` | 你启用的 Bing/百度/搜狗/360 或 Tavily/Exa 等 |
| 失败模式 | 凭据、端点、官方额度 | 反爬、网页改版、网络；多引擎 + 可选 API 兜底 |

### 什么时候仍然用原版

- 要求所有查询只到 DeepSeek、不接受第三方搜索引擎；
- 已经有稳定的 DeepSeek API 额度，且更信任官方结构化结果；
- 只需要单页 `web_fetch`，不需要批量收集；
- 对免费 HTML 解析的稳定性没有把握，也不想配置 API 引擎。

### 什么时候用本插件

- 需要中文多源结果、交叉验证；
- 想省模型 token，或模型本身没有官方搜索额度；
- 需要一次读多页、做调研、输出带出处的资料；
- 愿意用 Tavily/Exa 等 API 换取更稳的英文/技术结果。

## 1. 安装

先获取代码：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/a2042798096-debug/dsh-deepseek-search.git
cd dsh-deepseek-search
```

### 方式 A：双击脚本（推荐）

1. **完全退出 DeepSeek Harness**（不是最小化到托盘，是退出进程）。
2. 双击本目录下的 `安装.cmd`，或在 PowerShell 中运行：

   ```powershell
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
   ```

3. 脚本会把本目录以 `link:` 方式装进 `desktop` profile，并打印验证结果。
4. 重新启动 DeepSeek Harness。
5. 打开 **设置 → DeepSeek 搜索**，点一次“试搜”确认引擎可用。

### 方式 B：手动命令

```powershell
# 按你的实际路径修改这两行
$dsh = "D:\deepseekharness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
$plugin = "C:\path\to\dsh-deepseek-search"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$($plugin -replace '\\','/')"
```

如果 DSH 安装路径不同，把 `$dsh` 换成实际安装目录（目录下应有 `resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`）。

安装完成后，profile 的 `package.json` 会自动把 `dsh-deepseek-search` 加入 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles`；插件包内的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会把 `web.searchProvider` 切到 `deepseek-search`。

### 方式 C：在 DSH 插件页安装

1. 打开 **设置 → 插件**。
2. 选择“从本地目录安装 / 安装本地插件”。
3. 选中本目录，安装后重启。

> 桌面端同一时间只建议由一种方式安装，重复安装前先卸载。

## 2. 使用

安装并重启后，正常和模型聊天即可。例如：

- “帮我查一下 DeepSeek Harness 最近有哪些值得装的插件，列出来源。”
- “用 web_research 调研一下 2026 年国产大模型 Agent 框架的差异，deep 深度。”
- “把这三篇文章的正文抓下来对比：https://… https://… https://…”

模型会自己选择：

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `web_search`（原生） | 普通搜索，返回标题、URL、摘要；现在由本插件的多引擎链提供结果 |
| `web_fetch`（原生） | 打开单个 URL，DSH 自带，带 SSRF 防护与正文转换 |
| `web_research` | 多查询、多引擎搜索 + 抓取前 N 页正文 + 汇总；适合调研 |
| `web_collect` | 批量抓取指定 URL 的正文；适合已有链接 |
| `web_engines` | 查看引擎是否可用、配置路径、当前参数 |

### web_research 参数

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | 必填，主题/问题，建议关键词 |
| `queries` | 可选，额外的查询角度，最多 4 组 |
| `depth` | `quick`（3 页）/ `standard`（6 页）/ `deep`（10 页） |
| `maxPages` | 可选，1–10，覆盖 depth 的页数 |
| `includeContent` | 可选，默认 `true`；设为 `false` 只返回摘要/节选，节省上下文 |
| `engines` | 可选，指定引擎 id，如 `["bing","baidu"]` |

### web_collect 参数

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `urls` | 必填，1–10 个 http(s) URL |
| `maxCharsPerPage` | 每页正文上限，1000–50000 |
| `includeLinks` | 是否附带页面内链接 |

### 小技巧

- 问“最新/今天/价格/版本号”这类问题时，明确要求“用 web_research 查并给出来源链接”。
- 需要更全的中文资料时，在设置页同时打开百度、搜狗、360。
- 需要英文/技术资料时，填 Tavily 或 Exa 的 Key 并启用；它们的结果通常比网页解析稳定。
- 单页读不到正文时，先试 `web_fetch`；仍不行再用 `web_collect` 或换 URL。

## 3. 设置页

**设置 → DeepSeek 搜索**：

- 免费引擎：必应、百度、搜狗、360、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG。
- API 引擎：Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Brave、Serper。
- 每个引擎可单独启用/停用；API 引擎填写 Key 后才会可用。
- “抓取与结果设置”可调：每引擎结果数、单引擎超时、整次搜索超时、每页正文上限、深度收集默认页数、缓存时间。
- “试搜”会使用**已保存**的配置，直接显示聚合后的前 10 条结果和引擎来源。
- 某个引擎最近失败时，会显示“最近错误”；常见是反爬、超时或 Key 无效。
- 页面顶部有数据流向提示：查询会发往已启用的引擎/API 服务商，不需要的引擎直接关掉。

Key 只写入本机配置文件，设置页只显示 `••••` 加后四位；保存时留空表示保持原 Key。

## 4. 引擎与配置

### 引擎

| id | 名称 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bing` | 必应 Bing | 免费 | 开 | 默认走 `cn.bing.com`，可改地址 |
| `baidu` | 百度 | 免费 | 开 | 中文覆盖好；结果条数受反爬影响 |
| `sogou` | 搜狗 | 免费 | 开 | 公众号内容多；跳转壳会自动解析 |
| `so360` | 360 搜索 | 免费 | 开 | 作为中文补充 |
| `duckduckgo` | DuckDuckGo | 免费 | 关 | 大陆通常需代理 |
| `searxng` | SearXNG | 自建 | 关 | 填实例地址；需实例开启 JSON 输出 |
| `tavily` | Tavily | API | 关 | 需 `TAVILY_API_KEY` 或设置页 Key |
| `exa` | Exa | API | 关 | 需 `EXA_API_KEY` |
| `firecrawl` | Firecrawl | API | 关 | 需 `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` |
| `brave` | Brave Search | API | 关 | 需 `BRAVE_API_KEY` |
| `serper` | Serper (Google) | API | 关 | 需 `SERPER_API_KEY` |

### 配置文件

默认路径：

```text
C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh\deepseek-search\config.json
```

- 也可用环境变量 `DSH_DEEPSEEK_SEARCH_CONFIG` 指定其他路径。
- API Key 也可以放在环境变量里（配置留空时读取）：`TAVILY_API_KEY`、`EXA_API_KEY`、`FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`、`BRAVE_API_KEY`、`SERPER_API_KEY`。
- 参考 `config.example.json`。修改后可在设置页点“保存”，或直接重启 DSH。

### 关键字段

```json
{
  "engines": {
    "bing": { "enabled": true, "baseURL": "https://cn.bing.com", "weight": 1 },
    "tavily": { "enabled": true, "apiKey": "<your-tavily-key>", "weight": 1.1 }
  },
  "search": {
    "resultsPerEngine": 10,
    "engineTimeoutMs": 15000,
    "totalTimeoutMs": 30000,
    "maxEnginesPerQuery": 6,
    "cacheTtlMs": 180000
  },
  "fetch": {
    "maxCharsPerPage": 12000,
    "researchMaxPages": 6,
    "concurrency": 3,
    "readerBaseURL": ""
  }
}
```

- `weight` 影响 RRF 排序权重，默认必应 1、百度 0.95、搜狗 0.85、360 0.8，API 引擎略高。
- `readerBaseURL` 可选：正文过短时调用第三方阅读器，支持 `{url}` 占位符，例如 `https://r.jina.ai/{url}`。默认关闭。

## 5. 工作原理

1. **搜索层**：并行请求已启用的引擎，解析各自 HTML/JSON；单引擎失败只记警告，不影响其他引擎。
2. **合并层**：按 URL 去重，用加权 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 排序；多个引擎共同命中会加分。
3. **跳转解析**：搜狗/360/百度的 `/link` 跳转壳会被解析成真实域名，解析失败的结果丢弃。
4. **抓取层**：通过 DSH 的 `ctx.web.fetch()` 读取页面，复用其 SSRF 防护、DNS 校验、连接固定、重定向和大小限制。插件 bundle 补丁会同时固定 `web.searchProvider: deepseek-search` 和 `web.fetchProvider: http`；因为补丁层的 `config` 是替换而不是深合并，漏掉 `fetchProvider` 会让 `deepseek-fetch-api` 与 `http` 同时可用并报歧义。
5. **正文层**：轻量 HTML 解析，优先 `article` / `main` / 公众号 `#js_content` / CSDN `#content_views` / 知乎 `RichText` / GitHub `markdown-body`，按文本长度和链接密度选最佳容器。
6. **汇总层**：按域名分散选页（同域最多 2 页），并发抓取，输出标题、URL、来源引擎、时间、摘要和正文。

---

## 6. 安全与隐私

- 搜索请求发往你启用的引擎/API 服务商（必应/百度/搜狗/360 或 Tavily/Exa 等）；不会发往本插件作者的服务器，也没有遥测。
- 页面抓取走 DSH 的 `ctx.web.fetch()`，不会绕过它的公网地址校验。
- 不收集、不上传你的 Key；Key 只写入本机 `~/.dsh/deepseek-search/config.json`（尽力设为 0600），也可以改用环境变量。
- 工具输出会明确标注“网页内容属于外部不可信数据”，模型不应执行网页里的指令。
- 正文长度有上限，避免把超长网页塞进上下文。
- 本插件不执行网页脚本，不解析 PDF/压缩包/音视频；遇到这些会返回明确错误。

## 7. 故障排查

### 设置页没有“DeepSeek 搜索”

- 确认已重启 DSH（Host 插件必须重启，Client 页面才会出现）。
- 打开 **设置 → 插件**，确认 `dsh-deepseek-search` 已安装且启用。
- 查看 profile：`C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 是否包含它。
- 如果安装时 DSH 正在运行，先完全退出再重装。

### 原生 `web_search` 仍然走 DeepSeek 官方搜索

- 检查 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有：

  ```y

plugins.description: In-conversation keyword search with scroll-to-match for the DSH Web GUI — pages the session back to its start so a search covers the whole transcript.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-conversation-find

在当前 DSH 会话里按关键词搜索消息，并把命中项**滚动定位**到对话视图中的对应位置。

> 补的是官方 Trajectory 视图缺的那一段：轨迹能搜到内容，但它自己的 README 写明
> record/timeline selection 是 local 的、**没有 anchor deep links**，所以从轨迹无法跳到
> Chat 里的那条消息。社区现成的 `dsh-session-search-toggle` / `dsh-history` 又硬依赖
> 已在 0.2.x 被移除的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`，装不上。这个插件就是填这个空。

## 功能

- **搜索覆盖整段会话历史**：打开面板后先把会话历史翻到最早一页（面板显示「加载历史 N」进度），再在全文范围内搜索
- 会话头部（header utilities 座位）新增一个放大镜按钮，`⌘/Ctrl + Shift + F` 也能唤起
- 输入即搜（160ms 防抖），命中数显示为 `当前/总数`，`Enter` 下一个、`Shift+Enter` 上一个、`Esc` 关闭
- 命中项用**叠加层**高亮（当前项为橙色），不修改 React 拥有的 DOM，因此流式输出和重渲染都不会留下脏标记
- 跳转按 Range 的真实 client rect 把命中项滚到视口中间
- 流式输出时自动重算（400ms 防抖）；切换会话自动关闭面板

## 为什么要先「加载历史」

会话视图不是把整段对话一次性放进 DOM 的：它维护一个窗口，`hasMore` 为真时列表顶部有「加载更早」。
所以只搜 DOM 的话，结论会是「没找到」，而那句话其实只是还没加载。本插件因此先调用会话 store 的
`loadOlder()` 把窗口翻到起点（`hasMore === false`）再搜索；视图自己会监听 `loadingOlder` 并保持
阅读位置，所以翻页不会把视口拽走。

翻页上限 400 页：真的撞到上限时，命中计数会带「历史未加载完」提示，明确告诉你结果只覆盖已加载部分，
不会假装搜全了。关闭面板会立即中止正在进行的翻页。

## 安装

从 GitHub 安装（本仓库根目录即插件包，`link:` 指向克隆下来的目录）：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/vagur1689/dsh-conversation-find.git ~/dsh-conversation-find
dsh plugin --profile web add link:~/dsh-conversation-find
```

也可以直接 `link:` 到你自己的任意克隆位置（路径用绝对路径或 `~` 展开后的路径）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-conversation-find
```

然后重启 `dsh web`，再强刷页面（`Cmd + Shift + R`）。

> 用 `link:` 而不是 npm 安装，是因为本插件尚未发布到 npm；`link:` 的另一个好处是改源码后只需强刷页面即可生效（bundle 由宿主按请求读取）。

## 使用

1. 打开任意会话，点右上角的放大镜（或按 `⌘/Ctrl + Shift + F`）
2. 输入关键词，回车在命中项之间循环

## 边界（重要，避免误解）

- **只在当前会话内搜索**，不跨会话；跨会话需要另做检索层（读 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 或用 `session-query-sqlite`）
- **搜索前会翻页到会话起点**，因此第一次搜索需要等历史加载（面板有进度），超长会话耗时更明显；上限 400 页，撞到上限会提示「历史未加载完」
- 不搜输入框草稿（`data-composer-seat`），也不搜 `<script>` / `<style>` 和插件自己的面板
- 单次结果上限 2000 条命中、单帧最多绘制 400 个高亮框，避免一次按键把长会话卡住

## 实现要点

- 纯客户端插件：`index.js` 是空宿主半部，只用于让 Loader 挂载一个声明了 `dsh.client` 的包
- 运行时只 `require("react")`，不引入任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时模块（这正是它能在 0.2.0-rc.2 上跑的原因）
- 历史翻页走会话 store 的公开面：`ctx.get('sessions').binding(id).session.getSnapshot().hasMore` + `loadOlder()`
- 通过 `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.session.header.utilities', …)` 注册入口；`ctx.effect` 负责卸载
- 重复挂载用引用计数 + `window.__dshConversationFind` 单例收敛，不会出现两个面板或两套监听
- DOM 锚点只用官方稳定的数据属性：`[data-conversation-scroll]`、`[data-conversation-session]`、`[data-composer-seat]`

## 测试

测试用 jsdom 跑在真实 DOM 之上，不需要 DSH 运行：

```bash
npm install
npm test
```

覆盖的行为：

- `collect()` 命中数、大小写不敏感、跳过 composer / `<script>` / 插件自有 UI
- 面板开合、计数器 `1/2 → 2/2 → 循环`、Esc 关闭、高亮层释放
- 叠加层：每个命中一个高亮框、恰好一个 `data-current="true"`、几何来自命中 rect
- 历史翻页：打开面板后「更早页」里的文本可被搜到；撞上限时计数带「历史未加载完」；关闭面板立即停止翻页
- 降级可见：拿不到 `sessions` 服务时计数必须出现 `⚠` 与解释，不允许静默失败

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH界面美化 · DSH UI Beautify **语言 / Languages:** 中文（本页） ｜ **English**（点击下方「English version」展开） > 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。项目名 **DSH UI Beautify**：包名 `dsh-ui-beautify`，路由 `/dsh-ui-beautify/*`，全局 `__DSHUI__`，存储键 `__dshui.*`。 > 原包名 `dsh-dsniang-beautify` 的旧存档会自动迁移；旧 hash（`#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag`）与旧 URL 参数（`?dsniang=`）仍兼容。 > 仓库：`Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`（私有） **版本：v0.8.1** · 给 DSH 页面加壁纸与毛玻璃。 > ⚠️ **v0.1 出过事故**：它会改目标面板的 `position` / `overflow`，导致界面布局坍塌、 > 基本无法操作。v0.2 从设计上取消了所有这类改动，详见下面「为什么 v0.2 不会再弄坏界面」。 ---
English version（点击展开 / Click to expand） # English version **DSH UI Beautify** — a wallpaper + frosted-glass beautifier for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) desktop client. Package `dsh-ui-beautify` · routes `/dsh-ui-beautify/*` · global API `__DSHUI__` · storage keys `__dshui.*`. Settings stored under the old package name (`dsh-dsniang-beautify`) are migrated automatically; the legacy hashes `#dsniang-off` / `#dsniang-diag` and the legacy URL parameter `?dsniang=` still work. Repository: `Rad-Weed/DSH-UI-Beautify`. > This is the English manual. The Chinese manual above is the full one (troubleshooting, internals, release tooling). ## What it does - **Three modes**: **Off** (factory default — touches nothing) / **Texture** (multiply blending; the wallpaper is tinted into the UI) / **Backdrop** (the image is truly behind the content, with a scrim slider). - **Real frosted glass** (`backdrop-filter`): composer card, user bubbles, DSH dialogs and menus, the whale-widget panel, and — in Backdrop mode — code blocks and attachment cards in the chat. All share one parameter set. - **Two wallpapers**: drop `deepseek 4k.png` / `deepseek 黑白无水面.png` on your Desktop and those are used; otherwise the bundled WebP fallbacks are used (you always have two options on any machine). Switching is a cross-fade (no blank frame). - **Click the background** → fades to the default background (420 ms), then restores the wallpaper after **2 s**. - Clicking bubbles, the composer, buttons, links or icons is **never intercepted**. - **Built-in diagnostics** (`Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I`): mode, wallpaper source and health, glass state, frame rate — no DevTools required. - **Motion**: the shared foundation is in place (master switch **off** by default); decorative animations are deliberately left for later. ## Three buttons | Button | Effect | Does it touch the page layout? | |---|---|---| | **Off** (default) | Everything restored; nothing is mounted | No | | **Texture** | Multiply wallpaper (default concentration 0.49) + frosted glass (with "clearing" of the composer seat's own scrim) | Adds our own layers, a class toggle, and clears background colors (byte-exact restore) | | **Backdrop** | The image really sits behind everything (`z-index:-1`), with theme-aware scrim; the shell's full-screen opaque background is overridden by a class toggle; frosted glass works here too | Only our own layers + one class-toggle rule | ## Factory defaults | Item | Default | Stored in | |---|---|---| | Startup mode | **Off** | `localStorage['__dshui.mode']` | | Texture concentration | **0.49** | `localStorage['__dshui.opacities']` | | Backdrop concentration | **0.5** | same | | Scrim strength | 0 (slider 0–90%, 1% steps) | `localStorage['__dshui.scrim']` | | Wallpaper | **`deepseek 4k.png`** (shown as `deepseek`) | `localStorage['__dshui.image']` | | Frosted glass | **on** | `localStorage['__dshui.frost.v3']` | | Glass blur / white layer | **2 px / 25%** | same | | Panel white layer (top/bottom) | **97% / 83%** | same | | Bubble transparency / color / blur | **45% / original color / 12 px** | same | | DSH panel blur | **20 px** | same | | Motion | **off** (master switch; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M`) | `localStorage['__dshui.motion.v1']` | | Startup splash | **on** (Rhine-Lab-style loading animation; panel toggle, `?splash=0` or `prefers-reduced-motion` skips it) | `localStorage['__dshui.splash.v1']` | | Pill position | `10, 10` (top-left) | `localStorage['__dshui.pill']` | Defaults apply only when nothing is stored yet; once you move a slider, the stored value wins. ## Install 1. Extract `dsh-ui-beautify-0.8.1.zip` → you get a `dsh-ui-beautify/` directory (`package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib` / `assets` (both fallback images) / `test` / `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` / `README.md` / `HANDOFF.md` / `LICENSE` — 13 entries); 2. Put it somewhere that won't be deleted (an ASCII-only path is recommended); 3. Install it through the official plugin channel with the extracted directory as `target`: `pluginManager.installBundle('file:D:\\dsh-plugins\\dsh-ui-beautify')` (same as `dsh plugin add file:...`); 4. **Restart the DSH client** (the bundle stack is collected once at startup); 5. Self-check: `node test/host.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs` inside the extracted directory — all green. The official channel registers three things (all of them are needed, otherwise the plugin manager treats the bundle as a stray entry): the `node_modules/dsh-ui-beautify` junction, the profile `package.json` `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies`, and the `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer record. ## Uninstall 1. **Quickest** (no restart): `__DSHUI__.setMode('off')`, or open `...#dshui-off` and reload; 2. **Proper**: Settings → Plugins → `dsh-ui-beautify` → Uninstall (or `pluginManager.removeBundle('dsh-ui-beautify')`); 3. **Manual fallback**: `.rollback/` holds a copy of the pre-install profile config; restore it, remove the junction with `cmd /c rmdir "\node_modules\dsh-ui-beautify"` (links only), then restart DSH. After uninstalling, `scripts/uninstall-cleanup.ps1` runs the post-uninstall self-check: it asserts the "four-piece" state (`package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `node_modules/.modules.yaml`, `cordis.yml`) and removes a leftover `node_modules` junction (link only, never the target). Idempotent, supports `-DryRun`, writes a log, exit codes `0/1/2/3/4`. ## External side effects Pure Cordis plugin: it does **not** modify `app.asar`, the registry, scheduled tasks, environment variables or ports; no daemon, no child processes, no external network requests. Only six read-only loopback routes (`/dsh-ui-beautify/*`). Runtime changes are limited to our own DOM nodes, class toggles and CSS variables, all restored byte-exactly on teardown. The startup splash is a **same-origin iframe**; it is removed entirely when it finishes (or is skipped / times out) and never touches the host page CSS. ### User data All settings live in `localStorage` under `__dshui.*` (mode, opacities, scrim, frost, motion, splash, pill, image). Uninstalling **keeps** them by default. To wipe: ```js Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k => k.startsWith('__dshui.')).forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k)) ``` ## Diagnostics - Panel: `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+I` (or open `...#dshui-diag` and reload). - HTTP: `/dsh-ui-beautify/status.json` (wallpaper resolution) and `/dsh-ui-beautify/diag.json` (last report). - Console API: `__DSHUI__.status()` / `.wallpaper()` / `.reapply()` / `.uninstall()` / `.setMode('off'|'multiply'|'backdrop')`. ## Motion The motion foundation (master switch, `prefers-reduced-motion`, pause on blur) and the `requestAnimationFrame` frame-time probe are in place. Motion is **off** by default; `Ctrl+Shift+Alt+M` toggles it. All future animations must go through `motionAllowed()`. ## Startup splash On page load a **Rhine-Lab-style** startup sequence plays (black identity act → over-exposed wash → technical HUD → six authorization steps → white-flash cut into the session), then fades out and removes itself with zero residue. It is independent of the mode: it plays by default whenever the plugin is installed. - **When it plays**: on by default; skipped automatically under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, with `#dshui-off` (emergency switch), or `?splash=0`; `?splash=1` forces it on for debugging. - **Panel**: an "开屏动画：开/关" toggle (persisted to `__dshui.splash.v1`) plus "↻ 重播" to preview it anytime. - **Console API**: `__DSHUI__.splash.replay()` / `.skip()` / `.setEnabled(true|false)` / `.config()`. - **Isolation**: the splash is a **same-origin iframe** (`/dsh

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `allowedModels` | `[]` | Model whitelist, adapter mode only — legacy sidecar ignores it (plugin 0.3.14+, issue #83): exact model ids DSH may show and call. Empty exposes every eligible free-lane model. Narrowing only — paid/deprecated/blocklist/probe rules still win, and a direct call to a non-whitelisted id fails fast with a tagged error before any network traffic. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | **Local OpenCode delegation** (plugin 0.3.x, [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md), ref #76) — opt-in fallback for the persistent `403 FreeTierError` credential gate. Disabled by default; the anonymous path is unchanged unless you enable it: ```yaml delegation: enabled: true # arm the delegate (default false) # opencodePath: '' # explicit binary; else managed -> global -> npm # minVersion: '1.18.0' # candidates below this are skipped # memLimit: '96MiB' # GOMEMLIMIT for the child # gcPercent: 30 # GOGC for the child # trimIntervalMs: 60000 # Windows EmptyWorkingSet tick; 0 disables # startTimeoutMs: 60000 # health-wait budget ``` Enabling it makes the plugin custody your opencode credential (only the `opencode` entry, seeded 0600 into an isolated XDG root, never logged) and run a managed local `opencode serve` when — and only when — the anonymous lane *and* its sibling retry both refuse with the credential gate. Read [docs/delegation.md](docs/delegation.md) §2 before enabling. ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely ca

plugins.description: Transforms DSH sidebar into a dual-column Codex interface with Activity Bar
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-rail

English  |  中文说明

--- ## English Transforms **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** into a sleek, immersive **Codex-style dual-column workspace** with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, and smooth session history navigation. > [!NOTE] > **Author Disclaimer: This project is for personal use by the author and is a product of vibecoding.** > Crafted to bring a sleek, distraction-free, and immersive Codex dual-column workflow to DeepSeek Harness. Feature evolution and maintenance are primarily tailored to the author's daily workflow. Feedback, suggestions, and PRs are warmly welcomed! ### ✨ Key Features - 🎨 **Unified Titlebar & Activity Rail** Seamlessly fuses the native window titlebar with the 48px vertical Activity Rail, eliminating jarring borders, white gaps, and layout seams. - 🗂️ **Codex Dual-Column Layout** - **48px Activity Rail**: Consolidates plugins, web browser, terminal, and workspace switchers into a sleek vertical navigation column; - **Flexible Drawer Panel**: History sessions and side drawers slide smoothly, maximizing your conversation and coding viewport. - 👤 **Quick Account Center & Avatar Access** A dedicated 30px circular crystal avatar entry is pinned at the bottom of the Activity Rail for instant one-click access to account, profile, and model settings. - 🌈 **Wallpaper Engine Seamless Transparency** Deeply integrates with Wallpaper Engine plugins, supporting liquid glass blur, acrylic frosted sidebar, and full transparent mode with zero visual clipping. - ⚡ **Session History Navigation (Forward / Back)** Built-in browser-like navigation buttons with native global shortcuts: Alt + ← (Back) and Alt + → (Forward) to effortlessly traverse multi-turn conversations. - 🪄 **10px Floating Card Workspace** The main chat and coding area is wrapped in a refined floating container with subtle inner shadows and rounded corners for maximum visual depth. - 🚀 **Buttery-Smooth Animations** Optimized CSS transform transitions and GPU repaint boundaries, completely eliminating frame drops during sidebar expand and collapse. ### ⌨️ Keybindings | Shortcut | Description | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | Navigate back to previous session history | | Alt + → | Navigate forward to next session history | | Click Bottom Avatar | Open / focus Account Center & Profile Settings | ### 📦 Installation #### Method 1: DSH Plugin Market (Recommended) 1. Open DeepSeek Harness (DSH); 2. Go to **Plugin Market**; 3. Search for `dsh-codex-rail` and click **Install**; 4. Restart or refresh DSH to enjoy. #### Method 2: Command Line ```bash # In your DSH profile directory (e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop) npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` And ensure it is enabled in your `cordis.yml`: ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### Method 3: Local Symlink for Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # Create Junction on Windows: mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "path\to\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ Compatibility - **Compatible with DSH**: `>= 0.1.1-rc.1` (Full native support for DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 Desktop & Web) - **Platforms**: Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 中文说明 将 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 界面重构为极具现代质感的 **Codex 式双列活动栏**与**全窗一体化**工作区主题插件。 > [!NOTE] > **作者声明：此为作者自用且为 vibecoding 产物。** > 本插件旨在为 DeepSeek Harness 打造精致沉浸的 Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验。功能演变与日常维护主要依据作者个人实际工作流展开，欢迎交流体验与提交 PR！ ### ✨ 核心特性 - 🎨 **全窗顶栏一体化质感** 无缝打通原生标题栏与 48px 活动栏（Activity Rail），彻底消除断层与多余留白，与原生明亮/暗黑主题深度贴合。 - 🗂️ **Codex 级双列工作流** - **48px 图标活动栏**：将插件、终端、浏览器、工作区切换等功能归拢于左侧纵向 Rail，布局井然有序； - **弹性会话面板**：侧边列表支持平滑收展，留出最大化的主对话与编码视野。 - 👤 **快捷账号中心与水晶头像入口** 在活动栏底部常驻 30px 精美圆形水晶微质感头像与个人中心入口，点击即可直接呼出或定位到账号与模型配置。 - 🌈 **壁纸引擎无缝透光与毛玻璃兼容** 深度适配 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸插件，无缝支持液态磨砂毛玻璃（Liquid Glass）、侧边栏亚克力与全透模式（Full Clear）。 - ⚡ **会话前进 / 后退历史导航** 内置导航控制按键，并原生支持 Alt + ←（后退）和 Alt + →（前进）全局快捷键，顺畅穿梭于多轮历史会话。 - 🪄 **工作区 10px 悬浮圆角卡片** 主对话与代码编辑区域采用卡片化容器包裹，搭配轻量内衬阴影与圆角设计，层次分明，极具科技美感。 - 🚀 **丝滑动画与高帧率过渡** 深度优化 CSS Transform 与浏览器重绘机制，彻底解决原生在侧边栏折叠与展开时的掉帧卡顿。 ### ⌨️ 快捷键速查 | 快捷键 | 功能说明 | | :--- | :--- | | Alt + ← | 后退至上一个会话历史 | | Alt + → | 前进至下一个会话历史 | | 点击活动栏底部头像 | 快速唤出 / 跳转个人账号中心 | ### 📦 安装与使用 #### 方式一：DSH 插件市场安装（推荐） 1. 启动 DeepSeek Harness (DSH)； 2. 进入 **插件市场 (Market)**； 3. 搜索 `dsh-codex-rail` 并点击 **安装**； 4. 安装完成后重启或刷新 DSH 即可生效。 #### 方式二：命令行安装 进入你的 DSH 用户 Profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 或指定 workspace）： ```bash npm install dsh-codex-rail ``` 并在 `cordis.yml` 中确认启用： ```yaml dsh-codex-rail: {} ``` #### 方式三：开发者本地软链接调试 ```bash # 克隆仓库 git clone https://github.com/ComlaiGonnann/dsh-codex-rail.git # 在 DSH 的 packages 目录下建立软链接 (Windows 示例) mklink /J "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\packages\dsh-codex-rail" "你的本地仓库路径\dsh-codex-rail" ``` ### ⚙️ 兼容性说明 - **兼容 DSH 版本**：`>= 0.1.1-rc.1`（完美支持 DSH 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.1 / 0.2.1-rc.2 Desktop 与 Web） - **适用平台**：Windows / macOS / Linux --- ## 📄 开源许可 / License 本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源发布。

plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入递归自化能力优化，以及可视化调整
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-harness2

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

[![CI](https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.1--alpha.4-blue)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH/Cordis）的 Harness² 递归执行框架。在不修改模型权重的前提下，它针对一个明确任务运行 Base → INV/DOM 候选 → Probe → Compose，比较行为差异并返回采用结果；可选的领域经验库把有执行证据支持的经验用于后续任务。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 这是第三方社区项目，不是 Google 或 DeepSeek 官方产品。设计参考 Google Research 的 [Harness²](https://github.com/google-research/harness2) 与[论文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)，当前精确适配 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-alpha.4`。

## 当前能力

- 内置 DSH Web 可视化面板，展示 Base → INV/DOM → Compose 流程与文件/行级 Harness Diff。
- Parallel 和 Sequential 两种递归模式；一种模式约执行 `4k` 个 rollout 和 `3k` 个编辑/合成阶段。
- INV（通用执行能力）与 DOM（领域能力）分工、匹配 Probe、选择性 Compose、匿名最终选择。
- C1–C7 Harness 组件：system prompt、guardrails、memory、tool guidance、subagents、skills、scripts。
- Token/显式价格预算、超时、取消、失败回退、运行状态和脱敏生命周期事件。
- 按 `tenant/project/domain` 隔离的经验库，以及 Base 配对评估和 CI 发布门槛。
- 32 项自动化测试、真实 DSH AgentLoop 集成测试和 `k=1` 实机冒烟。

## 安全默认值

- 普通 DSH 任务不会自动触发；只有显式调用 `harness2_run` 才执行递归。
- Bundle 默认禁用，安装本身不产生模型调用。
- `k=1`、`libraryMode=off`、`enableScripts=false`。
- C8 middleware plugin 禁止自动生成或加载。
- C7 只支持固定的 `scripts/<name>.py` 工具，且默认关闭。DSH 当前 sandbox 不承诺网络隔离，不应把 C7 当作运行不可信 Python 的完整安全边界。

## 要求

| 依赖 | 支持范围 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` 或 `>=24.0.0` |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1-alpha.4`，源码 commit `86a402200d95fecef4529d969836f1fe13c6cb0d` |
| Cordis | `4.0.5-alpha.2` |
| Python | 仅开启 C7 时需要，命令名为 `python` |

DSH API 尚未稳定。其他 DSH 版本需要先更新 peer dependency、重新构建并运行原生 AgentLoop 契约测试。

## 安装

### 从本地源码安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WangHaiLongWang/dsh-harness2.git
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git

cd dsh-harness2
npm install
npm run link:dsh -- ../deepseek-harness
npm test

cd ../deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(cd ../dsh-harness2 && pwd)"
```

Windows PowerShell 可以直接传绝对目录：

```powershell
npm run link:dsh -- C:\src\deepseek-harness
cd C:\src\deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add "link:C:\src\dsh-harness2"
```

安装后在 DSH Plugins 页面启用 `harness2`，或在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中添加：

```yaml
- id: harness2
  name: dsh-plugin-harness2
  disabled: false
```

### npm 安装

本仓库已经包含 npm 发布元数据，但只有发布到 registry 后下列命令才可使用：

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-harness2
```

## 使用

首先运行零成本预检：

```text
harness2_plan
  mode: parallel
  k: 1
```

确认预算后执行：

```text
harness2_run
  domain: office
  mode: parallel
  k: 1
  task: <完整任务描述>
```

运维工具：

| 工具 | 作用 | 模型调用 |
|---|---|---|
| `harness2_plan` | 预览调用拓扑和预算 | 无 |
| `harness2_run` | 执行递归 Harness 改进 | 有 |
| `harness2_status` | 查询活跃运行 | 无 |
| `harness2_cancel` | 按精确 run ID 取消 | 无 |

## 配置

完整字段和风险说明见 [配置参考](docs/configuration.md)。推荐起点：

```yaml
- id: harness2
  name: dsh-plugin-harness2
  disabled: false
  config:
    mode: parallel
    k: 1
    timeoutMs: 3600000
    maxParallelProposals: 2
    maxParallelRollouts: 2
    maxTotalTokens: 100000
    libraryMode: off
    enableScripts: false
    tenant: default
    project: default
    dataDir: !!js dshHomePath('harness2')
```

设置货币预算时必须同时填写真实 provider 费率。插件不会猜测价格：

```yaml
maxCost: 1.0
pricing:
  inputPerMillion: 1.0
  outputPerMillion: 4.0
  cacheReadPerMillion: 0.2
  cacheWritePerMillion: 1.0
```

以上数字只是字段示例，不是任何供应商报价。

## 数据与审计

默认数据目录位于 `$DSH_HOME/harness2/`：

```text
harness2/
├── runs/<run-id>/summary.json
├── runs/<run-id>-<stage>/run.json
├── library/<tenant>/<project>/<domain>/entries.json
└── assets/                         # C7 临时目录，正常结束后删除
```

`harness2/event` 只广播 run/stage 标识、状态和 usage，不广播任务正文、轨迹或交付物。详细内容只写入 Run Store；部署者应自行设置目录权限、备份和保留周期。

## 评估

输入 Base 和候选方法的配对 observation JSON，可生成 Win/Tie/Loss、交付率、回退率、工具错误率、Token/费用/时延、Gain-per-Cost、bootstrap 95% CI 和上线门槛：

```bash
npm run eval:report -- observations.json harness2-k1
```

门槛不通过时命令返回非零退出码。格式示例见 [examples/evaluation-observations.json](examples/evaluation-observations.json)，方法详见 [评估指南](docs/evaluation.md)。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run link:dsh -- ../deepseek-harness
npm run build
npm test
npm run demo
npm run check
```

`link:dsh` 只在本项目的 `node_modules` 中建立开发链接，不修改 DSH 源码。CI 会检出固定 DSH commit 后运行相同测试。

## 文档

- [DSH 可视化面板与 Web Harness Diff](docs/dsh-visualization-panel.md)

- [架构说明](docs/architecture.md)
- [配置参考](docs/configuration.md)
- [部署与运维](docs/deployment.md)
- [安全模型](SECURITY.md)
- [评估指南](docs/evaluation.md)
- [实施状态](docs/implementation-status.md)
- [完整开发计划](docs/dsh-plugin-harness2-development-plan.md)
- [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [变更日志](CHANGELOG.md)

## 许可证与致谢

本项目使用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。Harness²、DeepSeek Harness 及其第三方依赖分别保留自己的许可证；本仓库没有复制 Google Harness² 的实现代码。来源与免责声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.description: DSH bundle that supervises the BrowserSkill (bsk) bridge daemon as a host child process: starts with DSH, stops with DSH, auto-restarts after crashes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bsk-daemon

[![test](https://github.com/XFY9326/dsh-bsk-daemon/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/XFY9326/dsh-bsk-daemon/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![package](https://img.shields.io/badge/package-GitHub%20Packages-2ea44f?logo=github)](https://github.com/XFY9326/dsh-bsk-daemon/pkgs/npm/dsh-bsk-daemon)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that gives the **BrowserSkill `bsk` bridge daemon** the same lifecycle as DSH: it starts with DSH, is stopped when DSH exits, is restarted after a crash (bounded), and is never confused with a daemon somebody else started.

This is a community companion to the upstream **[Tencent/BrowserSkill](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill)** project — see [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements).

Runs on **Windows, macOS and Linux** — see [Platform support](#platform-support).

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md) · [中文 Agent 说明](AGENTS.zh.md)

---

## Why this exists

BrowserSkill exposes browser automation to DSH through `bsk_*` tools backed by a local `bsk` daemon. Some agent hosts run shell commands in a sandbox that **reaps or forbids the daemon**. The concrete Windows case:

- a sandboxed child cannot break away from the Windows job object,
- it cannot write `~/.bsk`,
- it cannot open the daemon's IPC endpoint.

Linux agents hit the equivalent problem with `bubblewrap`-style sandboxes that kill command children. The documented workaround is to keep the daemon in a persistent host context and use local IPC from the sandbox — which is exactly what a supervisor in the DSH host process provides.

This bundle moves that responsibility into DSH itself: the daemon becomes a DSH child with a DSH lifetime.

## Platform support

| Platform | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | **Verified end to end** | Daemon started, stopped, restarted through the plugin in real use; job object also reaps it if DSH dies. |
| macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) | Supported, not yet run on real hardware | Same code path; IPC is a Unix domain socket, `bsk daemon stop` and signal handling are cross-platform. |
| Linux x64 / ARM64 | Supported, not yet run on real hardware | Same as macOS; the `bubblewrap` sandbox case is the closest analogue to Windows. |
| Node.js 22+ | CI matrix | The test suite runs on `ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest`, `windows-latest` for Node 22 and 24. |

Confirmed by the test matrix: module load, config validation, effect registration order and awaitable disposal on all three operating systems. A real `bsk` daemon is only exercised on Windows so far; a Unix run needs a machine with the CLI and the browser extension.

## Compatibility

| Component | Supported | Tested with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.x` profiles with bundle support | `0.2.1-rc.2` |
| Cordis plugin API | 4.x (`ctx.effect`, standard-schema `Config`) | `4.0.5` |
| BrowserSkill `bsk` | 0.3.x | `0.3.3` |
| Node.js | `>=22` | 22, 24 (CI), 26 (local) |
