plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - plugins.description: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness plugin: a switch in Settings that powers off the PC after the conversation finishes, with a native countdown dialog that cancels the shutdown in one click.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-shutdown

[中文说明](#中文说明) · Windows only · works with DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.1

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds **one switch in Settings → General**: turn it on, and
the computer shuts itself down when the next conversation finishes — with a native
Windows dialog that can cancel the pending shutdown with a single click.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown
```

Or install a prebuilt tarball from a GitHub Release:

```powershell
dsh plugin add https://github.com/873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown/releases/latest/download/dsh-auto-shutdown.tgz
```

Then restart the Harness (Host restart is enough) and look for the plugin entry
`auto-shutdown` in the profile.

## Use

1. Open **Settings → General** and find **“Power off after the conversation finishes”**.
2. Turn it on.
3. Finish a conversation: when that turn ends, the plugin
   - resets the switch to off (it is a one-shot trigger, never re-armed by a reboot),
   - schedules `shutdown.exe /s /t <delaySeconds>`,
   - opens a desktop countdown dialog.

The dialog offers:

| Button | Result |
| --- | --- |
| **Cancel shutdown** | runs `shutdown /a`; the machine stays up |
| **Keep shutdown** / close / countdown reaching zero | the planned shutdown happens |

You can also cancel from any terminal with `shutdown /a`.

## Configuration

All three fields are editable live from the Settings page and the Plugins page — no restart.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | The switch. It is set back to `false` right before a shutdown is scheduled, so the trigger fires exactly once. |
| `delaySeconds` | `60` | Shutdown delay in seconds (5–86400). The dialog countdown mirrors it. |
| `popup` | `true` | Whether to show the cancel dialog at all. |

## Safety notes

- No administrator rights are required; `shutdown /s /t` is available to the logged-in user.
- Only a **root** conversation can trigger it: turns of subagents/teammates are ignored, and
  if another agent is still running the trigger waits for the next turn boundary.
- `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN=1` in the Host environment logs the two commands instead of
  running them — useful for testing the wiring.
- `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_POPUP_LOG=<file>` makes the dialog append its user actions to a file.
- The dialog only ever runs `shutdown /a`; it never schedules anything.

## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): listens to the `agent/turn-stopping` event, filters to root
  agents, latches once, writes `enabled = false` through the Settings service, then spawns
  `shutdown.exe`. It is a validated Cordis plugin (`Config` with volatile fields), so the
  switch is a real Settings document write.
- **Cancel dialog** (`lib/popup.js` + `assets/notify.ps1`): a detached Windows PowerShell 5.1
  WinForms window with a countdown (always-on-top when ≤ 120 s). Its copy is passed as argv and
  the script itself stays ASCII-only, so a non-UTF-8 code page cannot mangle Chinese text.
- **Client half** (`lib/client.js`): registers one `settings.general.item` row that renders the
  switch from `ctx.configForms`, i.e. from the Host's own configuration form.

## Development

```powershell
# schemastery is only resolvable through a junction when testing outside the profile
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery `
  -Target "C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Roaming\DSH\data\versions\<version>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\schemastery"

$env:DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN = '1'
node test-dry-run.mjs        # host logic: filtering, disarm, argv, one-shot
node tests/popup-test.mjs    # real window: self-close, cancel path, failure path, shutdown /a
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force node_modules
```

`tests/popup-test.mjs` uses `-SimulateCancel -TestCancelCommand 'cmd /c exit 0'` style test
switches, so it never touches a real pending shutdown.

## Layout

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | Host plugin: event trigger, disarm, spawn `shutdown.exe` |
| `lib/popup.js` | Cancel-dialog argv builder + launch (shared with the tests) |
| `lib/client.js` | Settings row with the switch |
| `assets/notify.ps1` | Windows PowerShell/WinForms countdown dialog |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the Host entry `auto-shutdown` |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin list title/description |

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

Windows 专用。为 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个**设置开关**：打开后，**下一次对话完成时自动关机**，
并在关机前弹出一个原生 Windows 对话框，点一下即可取消本次关机。

### 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:873360545/dsh-auto-shutdown
```

安装后重启 Harness（重启 Host 即可），插件条目为 `auto-shutdown`。

### 使用

1. 设置 → **通用** → 找到「**对话完成后自动关机**」，打开开关。
2. 正常结束一次对话，此时插件会：
   - 把开关自动复位为关闭（只触发一次，重启后不会突然关机）；
   - 执行 `shutdown.exe /s /t <延迟>`；
   - 弹出倒计时对话框。
3. 对话框里点「**取消关机**」→ 执行 `shutdown /a`，电脑保持开机；点「**继续关机**」/ 直接关窗 /
   倒计时归零 → 按计划关机。也可以在终端随时执行 `shutdown /a` 取消。

### 配置项（均可在设置里实时修改，无需重启）

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | 开关。排定关机前会自动写回 `false`，保证只触发一次。 |
| `delaySeconds` | `60` | 关机延迟秒数（5–86400），也是弹窗倒计时时长。 |
| `popup` | `true` | 是否弹出取消窗口。 |

### 注意事项

- 不需要管理员权限。
- 只有**根会话**能触发：子 Agent / 团队成员回合会被忽略；若还有其它 Agent 在运行，会推迟到下一次回合边界。
- 设 `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_DRYRUN=1` 可只打日志、不真的关机；设 `DSH_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_POPUP_LOG=<文件>`
  可记录弹窗里的用户操作，便于排障。
- 弹窗只会执行 `shutdown /a`，不会自己排定任何关机。

### 许可

MIT

plugins.description: In-place selection translation for DeepSeek Harness — right-click selected text to replace it with Chinese, right-click again to restore the original. 右键划词翻译，再次右键还原。
plugins.readme_text:
# 划词翻译 · DSH Selection Translator

在 **DeepSeek Harness Web UI** 里选中文字后右键，菜单中除了「复制」还会多出「翻译成中文」。点击后，选中的英文会在原位置直接被中文替换；再次右键被翻译的文字，菜单变为「取消翻译」，点击即可还原原文。

![plugin icon](icon.svg)

## 功能

- 选中文字右键 → **复制 / 翻译成中文**
- 翻译结果**就地覆盖**选区，不弹窗、不新增消息
- 被翻译的片段带点状下划线，再次右键 → **取消翻译** 还原原文
- 中英混合选区会整体翻译成中文
- 菜单文案固定为中文（不跟随界面语言）

## 安装

发布到 npm 后，在 Harness 的插件管理器中安装：

```
dsh-selection-translator
```

本地开发时，克隆仓库后在插件管理器中从本地目录安装，或把该目录加为 profile 的依赖。

安装后会同时挂载 Harness 自带的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator`，用于提供匿名翻译服务，无需账号或 API Key。

## 使用

1. 在对话、工具输出或任意可选中的文本上拖选内容。
2. 在选区上点右键，选择「翻译成中文」。
3. 中文就地覆盖原文。
4. 对中文片段再次右键，选择「取消翻译」恢复原文。

## 隐私

选中的文本会离开本机，发往 Harness 的匿名翻译提供方（当前为 Microsoft Bing 的 Edge 翻译端点）。本插件自身不保存原文或译文，也不会随翻译请求发送会话 ID；翻译由 Harness 的 `translator` 服务完成，结果不落盘。

如果文本涉及敏感信息，请不要使用翻译功能。

## 已知限制

- 按段落/文本节点分别翻译，长文本会自动分段，翻译过程中菜单里显示进度条；极短片段（尤其是被行内代码切开的两段）译文可能不如整段通顺。
- 完整选中的段落会保留段落、标题、列表和行内代码/代码块；加粗、链接等不承载代码语义的内联样式会被拍平。
- 消息被 React 重新渲染（例如流式输出或切换会话）时，翻译片段可能丢失，原文会重新出现；重新翻译即可。
- 插件会插入 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator` 行；如果其他 bundle 也挂载了 translator，可能产生服务冲突。
- 百度翻译的公开接口需要 appid 和签名，本插件没有使用百度。

## 工作原理

- `client.js`：在 `shell.overlay` 槽位注册浮动菜单。Electron 桌面端的「复制」菜单由主进程生成，仅靠 DOM 的 `preventDefault()` 无法压制，因此右键按下时先保存选区再清空选区，让原生菜单没有可显示条目。
  - 完整选中的段落整段翻译，行内代码/代码块用占位符保留并原样放回；不完整的段落按文本节点逐段替换，保留原有 DOM 结构。
  - 长文本按 8 个片段一批发送，菜单里显示进度条；关闭菜单会取消进行中的翻译。
- `index.js`：Host 半注册同源路由 `POST /api/dsh/selection-translator`，调用 Harness 的 `translator` 服务把文本翻译成中文；超过 3500 字符的片段会自动切块翻译后拼接。
- `cordis.patch.yml`：同时挂载 translator 服务和本插件。

## 开发与发布

见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)；上架 DSH 插件市场见 [MARKET.md](MARKET.md)。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client plugin: live account balance plus the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) in the sidebar footer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-chip

**Two rows in the DSH sidebar footer:** your live account balance, and the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) with the clock time that window ends.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Agent install guide](AGENT-INSTALL.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

```
┌─ sidebar footer ─────────────────┐
│  Balance                  ¥12.34 │  ← balance row
│  Off-peak          ends 09:00    │  ← billing-window row
│  🟣 account                      │  ← built-in account entry
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

The balance row sits directly above the avatar / account row, the billing row right under it. Both register in the `sidebar.footer.action` list slot, so nothing in the built-in UI is replaced or wrapped.

> Why not inside the avatar row: that row is `settings.trigger`, a `single` slot already owned by `dsh-client-ui-settings-general`. `sidebar.footer.action` is the nearest free list slot in the same bottom-left block.

## What it shows

| | |
|---|---|
| **Balance** | Live wallet total from the same `account` Remote that Settings → Account uses. Bonus wallets are appended as `+¥0.50`; amounts truncate to cents with thousands separators; sub-cent amounts show `<¥0.01`. A failed read keeps the last number instead of blanking the row. |
| **Billing window** | `Peak` (amber) or `Off-peak` (green), plus when it ends — `12:00`, `tomorrow 09:00`, `Mon 09:00`, `Mar 3 09:00`. |
| **Hover** | Three short lines: state + countdown, the reason (peak windows / weekend / statutory holiday), then the pricing note and what a click does. |
| **Click** | Balance row opens your usage page (URL comes from the account state stream). Billing row opens the official pricing page. |
| **Collapsed sidebar** | Balance shows only the amount; billing shows only `Peak` / `Idle`. |

Every state renders something visible — loading `…`, signed out, no wallet, read failure — so "the plugin did not load" and "the plugin loaded but has no data" never look the same.

## Billing windows

The billing row mirrors DeepSeek's published rule, **in Beijing time (UTC+8)**:

- **Peak:** Monday–Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, **excluding Chinese statutory holidays**.
- **Off-peak:** everything else — 12:00–14:00, after 18:00, weekends, and holidays all day.
- Off-peak pricing is half of peak.

Sources: [Model & Pricing (EN)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) · [模型 & 价格 (中文)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) · 2026 holiday dates from [国务院办公厅关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm) (国办发明电〔2025〕7号). Pricing and windows can change — the official page is authoritative.

The judgement is pure local arithmetic (`Date.now()` plus the rule above), computed entirely in Beijing wall-clock time, so the result does **not** depend on the machine's time zone. On a machine outside UTC+8, the row prefixes `Beijing ` and the hover adds the local equivalent.

The statutory holiday table is compiled in (`lib/client.js`, `HOLIDAY_TABLE`) and currently covers 2026. Weekends moved to working days still count as weekends, so no separate adjustment table is needed. For a year the table does not cover yet, the plugin falls back to weekday-only rules and says so in the hover.

## Install

Requirements: DSH 0.2.x, and Python 3 for the installer. Node.js is optional — only the offline tests need it.

### Let an agent do it

Hand the repository, or the release zip, to your assistant and point it at [`AGENT-INSTALL.md`](AGENT-INSTALL.md). That guide covers environment checks, offline verification, installation, activation, reporting back, troubleshooting, rollback, and a no-Python manual path.

### By hand

```bash
python3 install.py          # macOS / Linux
python install.py           # Windows
```

The installer scans `$DSH_HOME/profiles/*` (default `~/.dsh/profiles`), copies four files into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-balance-chip/`, and appends one `insert` entry to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It does not touch the profile's `package.json` or `dsh.profile.bundles`, uses no network, and is idempotent.

Useful flags:

```bash
python3 install.py --list           # show detected profiles, change nothing
python3 install.py --profile web    # install into one profile (repeatable)
python3 install.py --uninstall      # remove the entry, keep the package
python3 install.py --purge          # also delete the package directory
```

Then let it take effect: press `Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R` in the window first; if that is not enough, fully quit and reopen DSH (macOS `⌘Q` — closing the window does not quit the process).

From a release zip: unzip `dsh-balance-chip-<version>.zip`, then run the same command inside it.

## Configuration

Every field of an entry's `config` is optional; an invalid value falls back to the default instead of hiding the row.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: balance-chip
      name: "dsh-balance-chip"
      config:
        windows: ["09:00-12:00", "14:00-18:00"]   # Beijing time; [[540,720],[840,1080]] also accepted
        weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                 # days treated as working days (0 = Sunday)
        holidays: ["2027-01-01", "2027-02-06"]    # extra dates, union with the built-in table
        ignoreHolidays: false                     # true = ignore holidays entirely
        zoneOffsetMinutes: 480                    # time zone the rule is defined in
        pricingUrl: "https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing"
```

## How it works

- **Two client rows, one host stub.** `lib/client.js` is the browser half: it renders both rows, reads the balance over the existing `account` Remote (`getBalance` for the value, `watch` for sign-in state and the usage URL) and computes the billing window locally. `lib/index.js` is the host half — it exists because the loader also imports every package on the host side, and it carries only a load probe.
- **One slot, ordered by `order`.** Balance `order: 10`, billing `order: 20`, both in `sidebar.footer.action` (`kind: list`, `scope: root`).
- **Pure function, thin component.** `periodAt` / `describeChip` are side-effect-free and exported as `exports.period`; the component only prints their output. The loader reads `apply` / `inject` and ignores the extra export.
- **No network, no credentials, no host code.** The only outbound action is `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")` on click. The only host-side write is a `/tmp` load probe wrapped in `try/catch`.
- **Theme tokens only.** Colours come from `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so light and dark themes both work.

## Compatibility

Developed against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.0.4` — the versions that ship with the desktop build it was tested on. The package declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency, so DSH's compatibility gate does not block it; what it needs at runtime is the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and the `slots` / `locale` / `remote.account` services.

## Development

```bash
node test-client.cjs .                       # balance row, fake Remote, no browser
node test-peak.cjs .                         # schedule, strings, tooltip layout
TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati node test-peak.cjs .   # same conclusions in another zone
```

Both suites are offline: a minimal React-hooks runtime, a fake `ctx`, and a fake `account` Remote. `test-peak.cjs` covers window boundaries, overnight and weekend spans, every 2026 holiday block, config fallbacks and tooltip line lengths, and prints a `SCHEDULE-FINGERPRINT` line that must be identical across time zones.

## Version history

| Version | Date | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1.1 | 2026-10-15 | Hover tooltips split into short lines; `aria-label` now a separate single line |
| 1.1.0 | 2026-10-14 | Added the billing-window row (peak / off-peak, end time, holiday table, config) |
| 1.0.0 | 2026-10-14 | Balance row only |

## Credits

Built by **Ivan Chen** and **[HugePaint](https://github.com/HugePaint)**.

Not affiliated with DeepSeek. The windows and prices it displays are DeepSeek's; the plugin only reproduces the published rule locally.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Ivan Chen, HugePaint

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, plugins.description: Harness² recursion: two auditable dsh plugins — task-level probe/compose evidence loop + harnessing-level experience library (frozen contract v4, 34/34 tests, real-session E2E)
plugins.readme_text:
# harness2-recursion

Harness² 递归方案 —— 两个互相独立、可分别加载的 dsh 插件（**第四轮冻结契约版本**）。

| 包 | 职责 |
| :-- | :-- |
| [`packages/harness2-task-recursion`](packages/harness2-task-recursion) | 任务级递归：Propose → Probe → `probe/completed` → 确定性 Compose 门禁 → 账本 v3 → `compose/applied`/`compose/rejected` → 下一个 pre-step 应用 pendingPatch |
| [`packages/harness2-meta-recursion`](packages/harness2-meta-recursion) | Harnessing 级递归：消费三事件 → 事后归因（edit 只取事实）→ 经验库 → 冻结只读门面 `harness2Experience` |

两个包的 `src/index.ts` **互不 import**；`src/constants.ts` **逐字节相同**。契约见 [CONTRACT.md](CONTRACT.md)，验收见 [SELF-CHECK.md](SELF-CHECK.md)。

## 目录

```
harness2-recursion/
├── CONTRACT.md                     # 第三轮冻结契约
├── SELF-CHECK.md                   # 第三轮 13 项验收清单逐项证据
├── README.md
├── package.json / tsconfig.base.json
├── test/loader-smoke.mjs           # 真实 Cordis 装载/事件/卸载 smoke
├── e2e/                            # 真实 headless 会话 E2E（安装/账本/applyMode/经验）
├── docs/                           # 社区 Discussion 提案 + 发布清单
├── LICENSE · .gitignore
└── packages/
    ├── harness2-task-recursion/
    │   ├── src/{index.ts, constants.ts}
    │   ├── lib/                    # tsc 产物（构建生成，不入库）
    │   ├── cordis.patch.yml · locale/ · icon.svg
    │   └── test/verify.mjs         # 15 项契约自检
    └── harness2-meta-recursion/    # 同上（13 项自检）
```

## 社区讨论

- 生态提案 Discussion（dsh 社区 `Show Your Plugins!`）：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/10324
- 本仓库：https://github.com/HeliosLz/harness2-recursion

## 验证

要求 Node ≥ 24（`node --test` 直接 import `src/index.ts`，依赖类型剥离）。

```bash
npm install
npm run build        # lib/index.js + lib/index.d.ts + lib/constants.js
npm run typecheck
npm run verify       # task 15 + meta 14 + loader smoke 5 = 34 项
```

本次结果（2026-10-19）：`npm run verify` **34/34 pass**；typecheck/build exit 0；`npm pack --dry-run` 清单齐全；真实会话 E2E 通过（见下）。

## 第三轮新增（相对第二轮）

1. **事件 schema**：`TrialRecord` 三个候选元数据字段必填（Q1）；`ProbeMetrics.tokenCostSource`（Q4）；`ComposeAppliedPayload.appliedEdits`（R3-1）；`ComposeRejectedPayload.rejectedCandidateIds`（Q3）。
2. **账本 v3**：`{version,id,previousSnapshotRef,ledgerEntryId,event,payload,recordedAt}`；只写 v3，`readLedgerTail` 接受 v2|v3 并做内存映射、不重写 v2 文件（Q7）。
3. **归因规则**：反射必须带 `edit.candidateId`，且与来源事实严格一致；写入的 edit 字段永远取自来源载荷（R3-3/Q2）；不一致 → `onError('reflection-edit-mismatch')` 且拒绝写入。
4. **confidence v3**：`base(0.6/0.5) × (0.5+0.5·min(1,trials/3)) × repeat(≤1.4) × sourcePenalty(estimated 0.9)`；`trials=0 → 0` 且不写入（Q4/Q5）。
5. **双注入阈值**：positive 用 `minConfidenceToInject`，negative 用 `minNegativeConfidenceToInject`（默认 0.3，Q6）。
6. **组件表**：`COMPONENT_NAMES` 八类冻结；7 项旧名迁移映射 + `migratedFrom` 审计；未知组件跳过并 `onError('unknown-component')`；移除 `workflow-control` 回退（R3-7）。
7. **token 计量**：Propose 用 `usage` chunk；Probe/baseline 用可选 `tokenMeter`；否则字符数/4 估算；同一 metrics 单一来源。
8. **第四轮增量**：新增终态事件 `propose/failed`（R4-1，与 Probe/Compose 互斥、append→emit、账本 revision 探测跳过它）；`rejectedCandidateIds` 只取 trials 中出现的 id（R4-2 正式契约）；`outcome.tokenCostSource`/`migratedFrom` 正式纳入 entry schema（R4-3）。

## 第三轮如实偏差（详见 CONTRACT §9 / SELF-CHECK §三）

- **无逻辑偏差**：第三轮 Q3 冲突已由 `propose/failed` 独立终态解决（原 `TODO(ROUND3_PROPOSE_FAILURE)` 移除）；预算早停的 rejected ids 与 entry 增量字段已追溯为正式契约。
- **环境依赖继续留 TODO/不验收**：`pre-step-patch` 运行时 API（dsh 0.2.1 无）、Probe 工具沙箱、profile 安装（第四轮执行）。

## 第五轮：真实环境验证 + 社区材料

### 真实会话 E2E（已通过）

```bash
# 需要 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 CLI 运行时（提取方式见 e2e/README.md）
E2E_CLI="<dsh-0.2.1-runtime>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js" node e2e/run.mjs
```

隔离 profile 内通过官方 `dsh plugin add` 安装两包，跑两次真实 headless 会话（假 provider：前 3 次主模型 500 → 触发 request-error 路径，随后延迟成功）。实测结果：

```
Ledger: 4 v3 records (2 probe/completed + 2 compose/applied)
applyMode: run1=noop-todo, run2=next-task-ledger
Revision anchor chain: null -> led-… -> led-… -> led-…
EXPERIENCE.md entries: 1 (confidence 0.50, measured tokens)
Sessions: 2 (exit 0)
```

- 首次 `noop-todo` 是冻结语义（插件激活时尚无账本可读）；第二次会话由 `readRevisionAnchor` 升级为 `next-task-ledger`。
- 完整证据与复现步骤：[`e2e/README.md`](e2e/README.md)、`e2e/artifacts/RESULTS.md`。
- 卸载残留：loader smoke 第 5 项验证真实 Cordis dispose 后 7 个监听器全部释放、不再写账本/经验文件。

### 社区材料

- [`docs/discussion-proposal.md`](docs/discussion-proposal.md)：Discussion 提案底稿（双插件契约、`propose/failed` 独立终态、元知识只改进编辑器三个差异点 + 34/34 证据 + 缺口 + 讨论问题）。
- [`docs/publishing.md`](docs/publishing.md)：Phase 1 原型仓库/npm/Plugin Directory 发布清单。
- `LICENSE`（MIT）、`.gitignore` 已就绪；两包 `keywords` 含 `dsh-plugin`（发布前移除 `private` 并改用可发布包名）。

## 安装（第四轮/第五轮）

```bash
cd harness2-recursion && npm install && npm run build
```

然后在 Harness Web 的 Plugins 页分别安装两个本地 bundle（target 指向各包目录）。默认 `observeOnly: true`：只取证、不应用 Compose。

plugins.description: DSH plugin + probe suite for Minecraft 26.3 mod development: start a real server and client, drive them over HTTP, assert on world state and logs (Fabric / Forge / NeoForge)
plugins.readme_text: # MC Mods Dev Bridge [![license: Apache-2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B6BFB.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows-2f2f2f.svg)](#requirements) [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-26.3-62b47a.svg)](#requirements) [![loaders](https://img.shields.io/badge/loaders-Fabric%20%7C%20Forge%20%7C%20NeoForge-e8710a.svg)](#requirements) [![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-25-important.svg)](#requirements) [![skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-11-4D6BFE.svg)](./tools/dsh-plugin/mcdev-devrun/skills) [![selftest](https://img.shields.io/badge/selftest-PASS-brightgreen.svg)](./tools/dsh-plugin/selftest.mjs) [![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge?label=version&style=flat)](https://github.com/7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge/tags) [![stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge?style=flat)](https://github.com/7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge/stargazers) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) > **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) | [Status](docs/STATE.md) | [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) | [Deployment topology](docs/deployment-topology.md) Turn "the AI finished writing a mod, and now a human has to click through the game" into one executable pipeline: **start a real test server → start a real client → connect + op → run a scenario JSON → collect evidence → tear down**, across **Fabric / Forge / NeoForge**. Target: Minecraft **26.3**, Java **25**, Windows. > This is **development tooling**, not a mod for players. The probe mod it ships exists only so that an agent can see and drive a real game. --- ## What it does - **Server probe** (`lab/shared/.../ProbeServer.java`): state, commands, blocks / NBT, drops, logs, tick control, action backend; block reads and writes take a `dim` parameter (unknown dimension → 400). - **Client probe** (`lab/shared/.../ClientProbeServer.java` + `action/ClientActionBackend.java`): UI widget tree, slots, scripted input (click / right-click / keys), screenshots, chat commands, `/chat/tail` (the chat and actionbar the client is **currently** showing, so you can assert "it really appeared on the player's screen"). - **End-to-end orchestration** (`scripts/devrun.ps1`): read the instance registry → start the server → wait for readiness → start the client → connect and op → run the scenario step by step → collect evidence → tear down; non-zero exit code on failure. Steps support `retry` (wait for a state to appear); assertions support exact match (`json`), field contains substring (`contains`), field does **not** contain substring (`notContains`), raw response body contains substring (`text`), and body does **not** contain substring (`textNot`); both probes expose `GET /mods`, which is how a cross-loader setup proves what each side actually loaded. LWJGL natives are extracted **once** into `.cache/natives/-/` (guarded by a file lock), so an evidence directory stays at a few dozen KB of logs instead of ~18 MB. - **DSH plugin** (`tools/dsh-plugin/mcdev-devrun/`): wraps the same orchestration as the `mcdev_devrun` / `mcdev_scenarios` tools, so an agent can call it directly. ## What it does not do **It provides capabilities, not answers to "what should be tested".** - **No test cases for any specific mod.** Which features to test, which text to assert, how fine-grained to go — that depends on what you are building at the time. The JSON files in `scenarios/` are **examples and self-checks**, not a coverage promise and not a recommended list. - **It does not replace your own hands-on pass.** Sound effects, the purple transition animation, F3 readouts, UI feel, how a combo feels — none of that has a data channel, so a human still has to look at the game. The suite takes over the part that *can* be verified automatically and leaves the human time for the part that only a human can judge. - **It does not decide "good enough" for you.** A green scenario only means the assertions you wrote hold; it does not mean the feature is complete. ## What this repository does not contain **No server, client, or loader files.** You prepare those on your own machine, then register them with the wizard: - `instances/` (instance registry, contains local absolute paths) is **not committed**; `scripts/setup-wizard.ps1` or `scripts/register-instance.ps1` generates it locally. - `dist/` (build output), `tmp/`, `lab/*/build/`, `lab/*/.gradle/` are ignored too. ## Built on top of This repository continues the work of **`yan-mc/minecraft-mod-dev`**, and that must be stated explicitly: | Item | Detail | |---|---| | Upstream tool | [yan-mc/minecraft-mod-dev](https://github.com/yan-mc/minecraft-mod-dev) | | Upstream license | MIT, `Copyright (c) 2026 yan-mc` (full text reproduced in [NOTICE](NOTICE)) | | Inherited and rewritten | the probe Java in `lab/shared/` + `lab/{fabric,forge,neoforge}/` (from upstream `lab/mcdev-probe/`); `tools/dsh-plugin/` (from upstream `plugin/minecraft-mod-dev/`) | | Upstream shape | MC 1.20.1 + Forge only + Java 17; tool surface was `mcdev_build` / `mcdev_prepare` / `mcdev_ui` / `mcdev_click` | | What changed here | MC 26.3; Fabric / Forge / NeoForge; Java 25; "start server + start client + connect + run scenario + collect evidence" collapsed into one `devrun` orchestration layer, with the tool surface `mcdev_devrun` / `mcdev_scenarios` | Also: - **The three build skeletons** come from their own upstream MDKs — Fabric `fabric-example-mod` (CC0 1.0), Forge MDK (LGPL 2.1), NeoForge MDK (MIT). The `LICENSE` / `LICENSE.txt` / `TEMPLATE_LICENSE.txt` files inside those skeletons are kept verbatim and are **not** relicensed under this repository's Apache-2.0. - **The DSH plugin layer** is written against DeepSeek Harness's public plugin API; DSH itself and its packages keep their own licenses. - Details: [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). ## Quick start Requirements: JDK 25; a Minecraft 26.3 server directory you installed yourself (**the level that contains `eula.txt` and `server.properties`**). Client-only setups do not need a server directory — that is what `side: client` in the instance registry is for. **Where the probe jar comes from** (`devrun` copies it into the server's `mods\`; the client side goes through `install-probe.ps1`): - Build it yourself: `lab\fabric\gradlew.bat build` (same for forge / neoforge); the artifact lands in `lab\\build\libs\mcdev_probe-*.jar`. - Or use the jar from a release package and pass `-ProbeJar `, or set `probeJar` in the instance JSON. ```powershell # 1) Register an instance (interactive wizard, or straight from the command line) pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\setup-wizard.ps1 pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\register-instance.ps1 -Name local -Dir '' -Loader fabric # 2) Environment check only (no game processes) pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\devrun.ps1 -Family fabric -PreflightOnly # 3) Run the smoke scenario pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\devrun.ps1 -Instance local -Scenario scenarios\smoke.json ``` Install into DSH (optional; restart DSH afterwards so the plugin loads): ```powershell pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\install-dsh-plugin.ps1 -Mode install ``` ### Install from the plugin marketplace (optional) This repository is also a DSH plugin package (`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle`, and the repository root has `cordis.patch.yml`): ```powershell dsh plugin add github:7starsseeker/MCModsDevBridge ``` `scripts/`, `scenarios/` and `tools/` are installed together with the package, and **the package root is the workspace root** — the plugin finds it on its own (you can also point `MCDEV_ROOT

plugins.description: Clean up conversations from the DSH sidebar: per-conversation file count and total memory, open/reveal/delete generated files, open the conversation workspace folder, and permanently delete conversations with their local session logs.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-conversation-cleaner

A DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin for managing conversations and their generated files.

## Features

- **Conversation overview** — total memory usage and file count for the current conversation, shown in the sidebar.
- **File actions** — open, reveal in Finder, or delete files generated by a conversation.
- **Workspace access** — open the conversation workspace folder directly.
- **Conversation cleanup** — permanently delete a conversation together with its local session logs.

## Install

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-conversation-cleaner
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-conversation-cleaner
```

The plugin is declared through `cordis.patch.yml` and exposes both a host entry (`index.js`) and a web client entry (`client.js`).

## Package layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host-side plugin entry: file operations, deletion, workspace access |
| `client.js` | Web client entry: sidebar UI |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH bundle patch declaration |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | UI strings (English / Chinese) |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` client packages.

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-portable

**Offline and online export/import for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): pack a whole working DSH home into one `.dshpkg` file and restore it on another machine — no network, no `pnpm install`, no manual path fixing.**

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) · [PUBLISHING](PUBLISHING.md) · [HANDOFF](HANDOFF.md)

---

## Why

Moving a DSH setup between machines is painful for three reasons:

1. A working profile is not one file. It is `profiles/<name>/` plus plugins **with their `node_modules`**, skills, hooks, task boards, storages, `AGENTS.md`, installed runtimes, and session logs.
2. Plugins are installed by pnpm from the network. An air-gapped machine, a locked-down corporate laptop, or a machine behind a dead proxy simply cannot run `dsh plugin add`.
3. Configuration files embed absolute paths (`C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh`, `/home/me/.dsh`) and the profile name, so copying the directory tree produces a DSH that boots with broken plugin paths.

dsh-portable solves all three: it packages a whitelist of roots into a single self-describing archive, refuses to walk outside that whitelist, and on import rewrites the six configuration files that actually contain machine-local paths.

## What goes into a package

| Root | Path | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `profiles/<name>` (config **and** plugin `node_modules`) | always |
| skills | `skills` | always |
| skills-disabled | `skills-disabled` | always |
| hooks | `hooks` | always |
| storages | `storages` | always |
| task boards | task-board / todo-board storage | always |
| browser host | dsh-builtin-browser-host | always |
| agent instructions | `AGENTS.md` | always |
| sessions | session logs | opt-in (`includeSessions`) |
| runtimes | downloaded runtimes | opt-in (`includeRuntimes`) |
| credentials | `.credentials.yaml` | **opt-in, off by default** |
| source maps | `*.map` inside the package | on (`includeSourceMaps`) |
| backups | `*.bak-*` next to config files | off (`includeBackups`) |

Anything not listed is never collected — there is no recursive "copy the whole home directory" step anywhere in the code.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-portable
```

The plugin has to be registered in the profile's own `package.json` — under `dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`. Copying the package directory into `profiles/<profile>/node_modules` by hand looks like it works, until that profile runs `npm install` again: npm treats an undeclared package as extraneous and deletes it, and from then on the panel still renders its cards while every request answers `404`. `dsh plugin add` (or `npm install dsh-portable` inside the profile) writes both halves.

Then open **DSH settings → Portable Migration** (便携迁移). The panel is registered at `settings.section` with order 70, and is bilingual (zh/en) automatically.

Nothing is written to the DSH home until you press a button.

## Using the panel

Six cards:

1. **Export** — pick which optional roots to include, name the file, press Export. Packing runs in a worker thread; the progress bar streams entry counts, and a 20 MB package over ~14 000 entries takes about 3 seconds.
2. **Packages** — every `.dshpkg` under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-portable/exports`, with size, modification time and buttons: Select / Download / Share / Delete (delete asks for confirmation). *Select* marks a package for the Import card below; *Download* streams it to the browser so it can be saved to disk and carried to another machine on a USB stick — the LAN share is only reachable while both machines are on the same network.
3. **Upload** — drag or pick a `.dshpkg` and it is streamed to disk (`.part` then rename) with a live percentage, so a 2 GB package never sits in memory.
4. **Import** — pick merge or replace (the active choice is highlighted), press *Preview* first (zero writes), then *Run import* — which opens an inline confirmation before anything is written. The result is a small key/value summary: applied items, rewritten paths, backup folder and warnings.
5. **LAN share** — publish a package as a one-shot download link (`http://<lan-ip>:<port>/d/<token>`). Defaults: **1 download, 60 minutes**, Range/HEAD supported, 410 on expiry or exhaustion. *Copy* puts the link on the clipboard and only reports success when the clipboard really accepted it (a textarea fallback covers plain-HTTP origins). No relay, no cloud, no account.
6. **Backups** — the automatic pre-install backups (`<DSH_HOME>/portable-backups/<stamp>`), newest 5 kept. Each one has **Restore**, which copies its files back over the live tree after first saving the current versions under `<stamp>-pre-restore`.

## Screenshots

Taken from the DSH settings panel. The DSH home path and the LAN share link in these images are placeholders.

![Export card and package list](assets/panel-export.png)

![Upload, import, LAN share and backups](assets/panel-import-share.png)

## HTTP API

Base: `/dsh-portable/api`. All responses are JSON except the download route and the uploaded-file streaming route. Authentication reuses the host's `connection.requestRejection` fence (cookie + trusted origin), and falls back to a loopback-only check when that service is absent.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/status` | host info, package counts, active job, share server state |
| GET | `/profiles` | profiles present in this DSH home |
| GET | `/jobs` | recent jobs (export / preview / import) |
| GET | `/jobs/detail?id=` | one job with live progress |
| POST | `/jobs/cancel` | cancel a running job |
| POST | `/export` | start an export |
| GET | `/artifacts` | packages available for import |
| GET | `/artifacts/meta?id=` | manifest of one package |
| GET | `/artifacts/download?id=` | stream a package to the browser as an attachment (save it to disk) |
| POST | `/artifacts/delete` | delete a package (confirmed in the UI) |
| PUT | `/upload/<name>` | stream an uploaded package to disk |
| POST | `/import/preview` | two-phase install, phase 1 (zero writes) |
| POST | `/import` | two-phase install, phase 2 (`confirm:true` required) |
| GET | `/backups` | automatic pre-install backups |
| POST | `/backups/restore` | copy one backup back over the live tree (current files saved first) |
| POST | `/share` | mint a one-shot LAN download link |
| GET | `/share` | list live links |
| POST | `/share/remove` | revoke a link |

**Everywhere a package is named, the API takes an `artifactId` such as `exports:machine-20261018.dshpkg`, never a filesystem path.** `/`, `\\`, `..` and control characters are rejected, so neither the model nor a web page can use this plugin to read or write an arbitrary file.

## Model tools

Registered on the host tools service (silently skipped if the service is absent):

| Tool | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `portable_export` | package the current profile; returns id, size, entry count, per-root breakdown |
| `portable_inspect` | read a package manifest without importing |
| `portable_import` | **without `confirm:true` it is a dry run**; with it, performs the two-phase install |
| `portable_share` | mint a one-shot LAN link (1 download, 60 min) |

## CLI bootstrap (target machine without DSH)

```bash
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 preview .\machine.dshpkg
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 install .\machine.dshpkg --yes

# macOS / Linux
sh bootstrap/install.sh preview ./machine.dshpkg
sh bootstrap/install.sh install ./machine.dshpkg --yes
```

Flags: `--home <dir>` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--profile <name>`, `--mode merge|replace`, `--keep <n>`, `--yes`. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure, `2` usage error. Without `--yes` on a non-TTY it refuses to write.

## Package format

`.dshpkg` is a gzipped tar. The manifest is the **first** entry:

```text
.dsh-portable/manifest.json
profiles/desktop/...
skills/...
hooks/hooks.json
...
```

```json
{
  "format": "dsh-portable/1",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T02:11:03.000Z",
  "tool": { "name": "dsh-portable", "version": "0.1.0" },
  "source": {
    "hostname": "WORKSTATION",
    "platform": "win32",
    "arc

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goes

plugins.description: DSH 交接鏈面板：把互相交接的對話聚成一條鏈（卡片／編號／面板／HUD／門檻提醒／自動交接）
plugins.readme_text:
# session-chains — 交接鏈面板 for DSH

把「互相交接的對話」自動聚成一條**鏈**：左側欄一張卡片列出每條鏈、每場對話編號，
點一下切過去；快到上下文上限時提醒你交接，設定打開的話連「開新對話＋貼提示詞＋切過去」都自己做完。

> 這是 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/) 的外掛（host 端 `index.mjs` ＋ 瀏覽器端 `client.js`），
> 以 `file://` 掛進 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`，不改內建側邊欄、不動 profile。

---

## 為什麼要做

拆對話是省 token 最有效的手段（同一條工作線實測可省約 71%），但代價是側邊欄散成一堆看不出關係的對話框。
而「哪幾場是同一條線」其實**已經寫在日誌裡** —— 只差沒有人把它讀出來：

- 接手的那一場，交接提示詞是使用者貼進去的**第一句話**；
- 交出的那一場，同一份文字是**助理產出的**。

兩側都落在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<工作區>/<session>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`。
所以只要提示詞裡有一行 `鏈=<代號>`，兩邊就都認得出來，面板自動分組 —— 不必手動歸類。

## 長什麼樣

| 位置 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 左側欄卡片 | 每條鏈一列，展開是各場對話（`001`、`002`…），右側三顆：收合／暫停／開面板 |
| 面板（浮層） | 全部鏈、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、四鍵排序（名稱／建立／場次數／最後活動） |
| 置頂／封存（2026-10-19） | **側欄每列右側就有 📌（置頂）與 🗄（封存）**，不必進面板。置頂只在右側顯示圖釘（左側不再加一個）；封存是兩段式（**側欄與面板一致**）：按 🗄 會變成「確定封存？」，再按一次才送，旁邊有「取消」。封存的鏈從卡片收起，面板「封存庫 N」才看得到、也才還原得回去 |
| 輸入框上方 HUD | `本場 320k/210` ＝ 這一場的上下文／請求數，達門檻才變色 |
| ⚙ 設定 | 字級、四組顏色、卡片圖示、HUD 五段開關、**交接門檻**、自動交接 |

> **置頂與封存存在哪**：跟改名同一份 `aliases.json`（`pinned`／`archived` 兩個清單），不是瀏覽器 localStorage，
> 所以換瀏覽器、重開 DSH 都還在；改名之後置頂也跟著走（讀寫時都會過對照表）。
> 封存**不動任何 session 日誌**，只是不在卡片顯示。封存的鏈若又交接出新場次，**留在封存庫**（不會自己跳回卡片）。

## 安裝

需要 DSH（桌面版或 web 版都可以）。兩種裝法，選一種：

**A. 從插件市場／`dsh plugin add`（repo 根目錄就是套件根）**

```bash
# 發佈到 npm 之後：
dsh plugin --profile web add session-chains
# 或直接從 GitHub：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains
```

**B. 直接掛本機資料夾（開發用，改檔即重載）**

```bash
git clone <this-repo> dsh-session-chains
cd dsh-session-chains

node scripts/install.mjs            # dry-run：只寫 .preview/，讓你先看補丁長什麼樣
node scripts/install.mjs --apply    # 真的掛上（會先備份 $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml）
node scripts/install.mjs --remove --apply   # 整包移除
```

掛好後**重新整理 GUI 一次**就會出現卡片。移除時它會把自己那兩段（插件列＋HMR 監看）一起清掉。

> **套件結構**：`package.json` 在 repo 根（市集與 `dsh plugin add` 只讀這個），裡面宣告
> `dsh.bundle.patch = ./cordis.patch.yml`（沒有這個就無法安裝，只宣告 `dsh.client` 不算）
> 與 `dsh.client.platform = web`；程式本體在 `plugin/`，`exports` 指過去。
> 本機用 file:// 直掛時，載入器會從 `plugin/index.mjs` 往上找到根目錄的 `package.json`。

> `install.mjs` 會寫兩段：`session-chains`（插件本體）與 `session-chains-hmr`（把 `plugin/` 加進 HMR 的監看根目錄，
> 沒有這段改 `index.mjs` 不會生效）。兩段都用哨兵包住，可重複執行。

## 使用

1. **平常**：照常工作。交接過的對話會自己出現在同一條鏈裡。
2. **要交接時**：面板上按「生成交接詞」→ AI 寫交接單與提示詞 → 按「開新對話」自動開＋貼＋送出＋切換。
3. **到門檻**：畫面會跳提醒（warn 可延後 30 分鐘、hard 只能延後 5 分鐘）。
   打開 ⚙ 的「到達門檻自動交接」，hard 會在這一輪結束後**自己**做完上面第 2 步。

## 門檻（預設值與怎麼選）

| 訊號 | 提醒（warn） | 強制（hard） |
|---|---|---|
| 請求數 | ≥ 200 | ≥ 320 |
| 上下文 tokens | ≥ 320k | ≥ 480k |
| 佔模型視窗比例 | ≥ 50% | ≥ 65% |

- **warn 是提示**（只顯示，不動作）；**hard 才是緊急煞車**（設了自動交接才會出手）。
- 預設值是回放 42 場真實對話訂出來的：舊的 80／120、160k／240k 會在 25/42 場觸發
  （觸發時中位還剩 103 步＝一定半路被切）；現在只在 6/42 場觸發，都是 300 步以上或 470k 以上的長場。
- 比例那一列是給**換模型**用的：1M 視窗下幾乎不會先觸發，換成 200k 視窗的模型時它會自動先擋。
- 全部可在 ⚙ 改，或直接改 localStorage 的 `dsh.session-chains.settings`。

## 運作原理（三個判定）

| 訊號 | 規則 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|
| 接手 1 | 第一句話有明確標記 | `鏈=my-project` |
| 接手 2 | 舊式提示詞 | `接續 my-project：讀 …` |
| 接手 3 | 第一句話裡的專案路徑 | `30-CodingSkills/my-project` |
| 交出 | **助理訊息裡「整行就是標記」** | 產出的提示詞那一行 |
| — | 都沒有 → 未標記 | 一般對話 |

「交出」那一條刻意嚴格（行首就是標記）：實測一場正在討論本功能的對話，助理推理裡
`鏈=…` 這種字串出現 23 次（全在行內），寬鬆比對會把一般對話誤認成鏈的起點。

**交接時的鏈代號由面板填好**（2026-10-20 修）：交接指令會直接寫「那一行整行就是
`鏈=<這一場的鏈>`」，不再叫 AI「沿用第一句話的鏈或專案目錄名」；新開的場次也會立刻
歸回同一條鏈。原因是後者會沿用舊代號，再被對照表併到別條鏈 —— 實際事故是
「本地部署測試004 一開始被丟到模擬聲音工程」。

**交接會沿用這一場的模型**（2026-10-20 修）：新對話一律先吃部署預設（例如雲端），所以
面板在建立新對話後、送出第一句**之前**，會把這一場最後選用的模型（日誌裡的
`model/selection`，沒有就退回最後一次請求的設定）選給新對話。

怎麼選：**走宿主路由** `POST /local/session-chains.select-model`（宿主直接呼叫
`sessionController.selectModel`，與 UI 的模型選單同一個方法），成功失敗都回得出原因；
舊宿主沒有這條路時才退回瀏覽器的 `ctx.remote.session.selectModel`。

> 面板標題旁會顯示 `v0.1.7`。改了外掛之後如果數字沒變，就是**頁面還跑舊的 bundle**——
> 按一次重新整理（Cmd+R）再試。

## 測試

```bash
node --test scripts/          # 單元測試（純函式：鏈判定、編號、改名、建議歸鏈）
node scripts/smoke.mjs        # 端到端：在沙箱裡跑 client bundle，檢查面板／卡片／交接流程
node scripts/verify.mjs       # 靜態：manifest、bundle 形式、補丁現況
DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51714 node scripts/probe.mjs   # 實機：宿主是否已把 bundle 組進 boot graph
```

`scripts/smoke.mjs` 不需要真的 DSH：它自己造假的宿主 API（sessions、workspace、fetch、localStorage），
所以 CI 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只支援 DSH**：它讀的是 DSH 自己的 session 日誌格式（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），換宿主就得改 `chains.mjs`。
- **紅點還沒有資料來源**：宿主目前沒有「這一場失敗了」的狀態可讀，所以失敗圓點先留空。
- **手動「交接→新對話」在沒有交接詞時會顯示兩步錯誤**（設計如此：先按「生成交接詞」）。
- 鏈的判定靠提示詞裡的標記；沒用過交接指令的舊對話會落在「未標記」，可在面板上逐一歸鏈。

## 授權

MIT，見 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Force the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-thinking-zh

让 DeepSeek Harness 里模型的**内部思考（reasoning / thinking）使用简体或繁体中文**，并可选择让**最终回复**也使用指定中文。

> 非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 无关。英文说明见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。

## 30 秒看懂

| 你想做的事 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 装完就能用 | 默认简体中文思考，回复跟随用户，不用配置 |
| 确认已生效 | 日志出现 `已启用 — 思考：简体中文 / 回复：跟随用户` |
| 在对话里查状态或切换 | 输入 `/thinking-zh` |
| 思考换繁体 | `config.thinkingLanguage: zh-TW` |
| 让回复也用中文 | `config.replyLanguage: zh-CN` |
| 放宽要求 | `config.mode: prefer` |
| 关掉 | `config.enabled: false` |

## 它做什么

- **思考段落（始终注册）**：要求模型的内部思考与推理使用简体或繁体中文；
  - 代码、命令、路径、API 名、错误原文、专有名词保持原样；
  - 中文推理不得省略步骤、降低严谨度；
  - 用户明确要求换语言时，以用户要求为准。
- **回复段落（可选注册）**：`replyLanguage` 不是 `auto` 时，要求最终回复使用指定中文；
  - 用户明确要求其他语言时仍然以用户为准。
- 只改提示词，不改 DSH 程序文件、不改 UI、不发网络请求。

## 安装

从 npm：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-thinking-zh
```

从本地 tarball：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:/path/to/dsh-thinking-zh-0.2.1.tgz"
```

然后确认 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `"dsh-thinking-zh"`，**完全退出并重开 DSH**（包括托盘图标）。

## 配置

四个字段，全部可选。写错只会回退默认并打一条警告，不会让 DSH 启动失败。

```yaml
- id: dsh-thinking-zh
  name: dsh-thinking-zh
  config:
    enabled: true           # 默认 true
    thinkingLanguage: zh-CN # zh-CN | zh-TW
    replyLanguage: auto     # auto | zh-CN | zh-TW
    mode: strict            # strict | prefer
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 可选值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `true` / `false` | 关闭后不注册任何段落 |
| `thinkingLanguage` | `zh-CN` | `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` | 内部思考语言，繁体同时调整用词 |
| `replyLanguage` | `auto` | `auto` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` | `auto` 跟随用户；指定后约束最终回复 |
| `mode` | `strict` | `strict` / `prefer` | `strict` 发现英文思考立即改回；`prefer` 只要求尽量 |

`language` 是 0.2.0 的旧字段，仍然兼容，等价于 `thinkingLanguage`，但会提示弃用。新配置请使用 `thinkingLanguage`。

配置固定时提示词完全稳定，不会在请求之间抖动，也不影响 KV cache。

## 状态命令

在交互式 UI 中：

```text
/thinking-zh                 查看当前状态
/thinking-zh zh-TW           本会话切换为繁体思考
/thinking-zh zh-CN           本会话切换为简体思考
/thinking-zh reply zh-CN     本会话让最终回复使用简体中文
/thinking-zh reply auto      本会话让回复重新跟随用户
/thinking-zh prefer          本会话放宽为 prefer
/thinking-zh strict          本会话切回 strict
/thinking-zh off             本会话关闭
/thinking-zh on              本会话重新启用
/thinking-zh reset           清除本会话所有覆盖
```

这些切换**只影响当前会话**，不改全局配置、不需要重启。底层用 agent 作用域段落遮蔽全局段落，会话结束自动清理。

没有命令服务的环境（如纯 ACP）会自动跳过，不影响提示词。

## 确认生效

日志里出现这一行就说明生效：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 已启用 — 思考：简体中文 / 回复：跟随用户 / 严格模式（order=6000）
```

关闭时：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 配置中已关闭，未注册提示词段落
```

注册失败时会有带修复建议的警告，例如检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有同名段落。

## 与同类插件的区别

以下是 2026-10 的公开信息，竞品可能已更新。对比对象是 npm 和 GitHub 上定位相近的插件。

| 插件 | 思考语言 | 回复语言 | 简/繁 | 严格/宽松 | 会话级切换 | 零运行时依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **dsh-thinking-zh（本插件）** | ✅ | ✅ 可独立开关 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `@tirol/dsh-language-set` | ✅ | ✅ 可独立开关 | 仅中/英 | ❌ | ❌（只有全局命令） | ❌ peer 依赖 |
| `@max-null/dsh-chinese-thinking` | ✅ | ✅ 同一条要求 | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ peer 依赖 |
| `yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking` | ✅ | ❌ | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| `dsh-reasoning-cn` | ✅ + 翻译 reasoning | ❌ | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | 未核实 |

本插件的差异点：简/繁双语言、`strict`/`prefer` 强度、思考与回复解耦、会话级切换、零运行时依赖、16 个冒烟测试。

## FAQ

**模型偶尔还是用英文思考？**
提示词只能引导，不能强制。保持 `mode: strict`（默认），或在对话里直接要求“用中文思考”。

**改了配置没生效？**
插件配置在启动时读取，改完需要完全退出并重开 DSH。临时切换请用 `/thinking-zh`。

**`/thinking-zh` 切换会改全局配置吗？**
不会。它只注册当前会话的遮蔽段落，`reset` 或会话结束即恢复全局配置。

**支持繁体吗？**
支持 `zh-TW`，用词会一起调整（程式碼 / 檔案 / 使用者）。

**旧配置 `language` 还能用吗？**
能。它等价于 `thinkingLanguage`，但会提示弃用；建议迁移。

**会不会重复注册？**
段落名带命名空间前缀；同一作用域内重复注册会报错，日志会提示检查 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 卸载

从 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 中删掉 `dsh-thinking-zh`，
再执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH 即可。它不写入任何用户数据。

## 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主插件：配置、日志、两段提示词注册、会话命令 |
| `lib/text.js` | 思考/回复 × 简繁 × 严格/宽松 文本模板 |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | 冒烟测试 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：把自己插入 profile 的组合 |
| `package.json` | 包声明，`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向上面的 patch |
| `README.en.md` | 英文说明 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本记录 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 |

## 安全说明

- 无网络、无文件读写、无子进程、无凭据访问；
- 只新增提示词段落，不覆盖、不删除任何已有段落；
- 段落名带命名空间前缀，避免与其他插件冲突。

## 兼容性

- 只用公开的 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 与可选的 `ctx.commands`，不 import 任何 DSH 内部模块；
- `inject = ['systemPrompt']`：服务不存在时插件静默不激活；
- 固定段落顺序 `6000` / `6001`，不依赖未来可能改动的顺序表；
- 纯 ESM、零运行时依赖、无客户端（client）部分。

plugins.description: Sensitive-data guard for DeepSeek Harness: blocks credential reads/outbound secrets and redacts secrets, tokens, and PII before they reach the model, logs, or spill files.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sensitive-guard

🇬🇧 English · 🇨🇳 [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![CodeQL](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/actions/workflows/codeql.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A host-only security plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh): it **blocks credential reads and outbound secrets**, and **redacts secrets, tokens, and PII** before they reach the model, the session log, or a spill file.

> Status: **0.0.0, pre-release**. The interception and redaction vertical slice is implemented and tested. Planned work is tracked in GitHub Issues (see [Roadmap](#roadmap)); do not describe planned capabilities as available.

## What it covers

| #   | Leak path                           | Coverage                                                                          |
| --- | ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | User paste → model request          | ✅ `agent/pre-step` (the committed `user/message` is redacted too)                |
| 2   | Tool read → model                   | ✅ `tools/pre-execute` path/argv/URL gate + `tools/post-execute` result redaction |
| 3   | Tool result → spill file            | ✅ post-execute short-circuits downstream policies on a hit                       |
| 4   | PTC sub-call log copy               | ✅ `tools/ptc-dispatch-log`                                                       |
| 5   | System prompt / runtime context     | ✅ `system-prompt/assemble`                                                       |
| 6   | Session inbox original              | ⚠️ partial: `agent/inbox/spliced` keeps the user's original text                  |
| 7   | Assistant repetition                | ❌ no public rewrite hook                                                         |
| 8   | Images / screenshots                | ❌ no OCR                                                                         |
| 9   | Third-party plugins / MCP internals | ❌ outside the DSH tool pipeline                                                  |
| 10  | Model-provider retention            | ❌ contractual choice, not a plugin concern                                       |

The guard only constrains content that traverses DSH's tool and message pipelines. A destination-level egress guard is planned for v2 (issue [#5](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/issues/5)): it enforces where connections may go, not what they carry, and deliberately does not intercept TLS.

## Features

- **Two layers**: a fail-closed allow/deny/ask gate and a redaction layer.
- **Five hooks**: pre-step, pre-execute, post-execute, PTC dispatch log, system-prompt assembly.
- **Rules**: user YAML rules + generated path policy + a vendored high-risk baseline (destructive commands, RCE, credential paths).
- **Detection**: tiered secret rules (PEM, provider keys, JWTs, URL credentials, assignments) and PII (email, phone, CN ID, card with Luhn, SSN) plus a high-entropy fallback.
- **Stable placeholders**: secrets use `[SECRET:<category>:<id>]` (one-way); PII uses keyed `[[PII_<TYPE>_<hash8>]]` (stable across sessions).
- **Audit**: JSONL with rule ids, counts, and hashes only — never plaintext, secrets, or full paths.
- **Observe first**: `mode: monitor` audits without blocking.
- **Optional notice**: `redact.notify` appends one count-only message when a step is redacted.

## Roadmap

All planned work is tracked in GitHub Issues. Start with the
[roadmap label](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aroadmap);
the issue list is the single source of truth.

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (peer range `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`)
- A profile with the `tools` service (base bundle)

## Install

### From GitHub Release

Verify the download against the `SHA256SUMS` asset from the same release, then
install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add \
  https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/releases/latest/download/dsh-sensitive-guard.tgz
```

### Agent-assisted install

Point a coding agent at [docs/agent-install.md](docs/agent-install.md), or give
it this prompt:

> Install dsh-sensitive-guard into my DSH web profile by following
> https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/blob/main/docs/agent-install.md

The guide covers the single install command, verification, restart, optional
`enforce` configuration, and rollback.

### From npm (planned)

Tracked in [#6](https://github.com/gythialy/dsh-sensitive-guard/issues/6). The
future npmjs release will use the same scoped name.

### From source (development)

```bash
# from the repository root
pnpm install
pnpm verify

# link the checkout into one profile; this writes ~/.dsh and needs approval
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD"
```
